# 202.100. Network invariants — `ANET`

### `ANET-20`
Network resources shall be explicit owned resources.

### `ANET-21`
Raw OS handles shall not implicitly become safe resource owners.

### `ANET-22`
Socket types shall model meaningful protocol/resource distinctions.

### `ANET-23`
Async I/O shall preserve buffer validity until operation completion.

### `ANET-24`
Async I/O shall not require programmer-written lifetime annotations.

### `ANET-25`
Owned buffers may be moved into pending operations.

### `ANET-26`
Borrowed buffers may only be used when their capability lifetime is proven safe.

### `ANET-27`
Zero-copy shall be permitted when ownership, layout and backend contracts allow it.

### `ANET-28`
Zero-copy shall never silently alter ownership semantics.

### `ANET-29`
Scatter/gather operations shall respect capability overlap rules.

### `ANET-30`
Network input shall be treated as externally sourced data.

### `ANET-31`
Deserialization shall validate bounds, layout, alignment and representation before safe exposure.

### `ANET-32`
Wire representation shall remain distinct from ordinary memory representation.

### `ANET-33`
Wire endianness shall be explicit.

### `ANET-34`
Network framing shall be explicit.

### `ANET-35`
TCP APIs shall not imply message boundaries.

### `ANET-36`
UDP APIs shall not imply delivery or ordering guarantees absent a protocol contract.

### `ANET-37`
Cancellation shall be distinct from dropping a Future.

### `ANET-38`
Cancellation races shall have defined completion semantics.

### `ANET-39`
Timeouts and deadlines shall be explicit policy abstractions.

### `ANET-40`
Backpressure shall be representable without unbounded buffering.

### `ANET-41`
Network operations shall expose appropriate external effects.

### `ANET-42`
Async networking shall reuse the Axiom Future/executor model.

### `ANET-43`
OS-specific I/O backends shall be hidden behind portable abstractions where possible.

### `ANET-44`
io_uring, IOCP, epoll and kqueue shall be backend implementations, not separate language semantics.

### `ANET-45`
Connection pooling shall preserve resource and pending-operation lifetimes.

### `ANET-46`
RPC shall remain a library/framework abstraction.

### `ANET-47`
RPC contracts shall distinguish transport, protocol, serialization and application errors.

### `ANET-48`
RPC retry shall not be implicit solely from function type.

### `ANET-49`
RPC idempotency shall be explicit when relevant.

### `ANET-50`
RPC streaming shall use explicit stream semantics.

### `ANET-51`
Network Send shall remain distinct from Axiom `Send`.

### `ANET-52`
Distributed transfer shall not imply local shared ownership.

### `ANET-53`
Shared memory shall remain distinct from network transport.

### `ANET-54`
DMA/RDMA resources shall have explicit storage, lifetime and completion contracts.

### `ANET-55`
Foreign asynchronous operations shall provide sufficient FFI contracts for safe wrappers.

### `ANET-56`
Unknown foreign I/O behavior shall be treated conservatively.

### `ANET-57`
High-performance networking shall support reactor/completion-based execution without thread-per-connection requirements.

### `ANET-58`
Network server architecture shall support bounded worker/task scheduling.

### `ANET-59`
Protocol parsing shall be separable from transport effects.

### `ANET-60`
Zero-copy parsing shall preserve source capability validity.

### `ANET-61`
Generated serialization/RPC code shall pass normal compiler verification.

### `ANET-62`
Network optimizations shall preserve ownership, capability and protocol semantics.

### `ANET-63`
Network runtime components shall be optional.

### `ANET-64`
A program not using networking shall not acquire network runtime dependencies.

### `ANET-65`
WASM and freestanding targets may provide different network capabilities without changing Core semantics.

### `ANET-66`
Network security shall remain distinct from memory safety.

### `ANET-67`
Cryptographic constant-time contracts shall remain explicit.

### `ANET-68`
Network diagnostics shall expose buffer, ownership, capability, async and effect reasoning.

### `ANET-69`
Compiler optimization shall eliminate redundant network-buffer transformations only when semantics permit.

### `ANET-70`
Axiom networking shall not require a garbage collector.

### `ANET-71`
Axiom networking shall not require a monolithic runtime.

### `ANET-72`
Axiom networking shall support native high-performance I/O while preserving programmer-level semantic simplicity.

# Kiến trúc Networking hoàn chỉnh

```text
                         AXIOM NETWORK
                              │
         ┌────────────────────┼────────────────────┐
         │                    │                    │
      Transport             RPC                 IPC
         │                    │                    │
   ┌─────┼─────┐        Serialization       Shared Memory
   │     │     │             │                    │
  TCP   UDP   QUIC           │                  Channel
   │     │     │             │
   └─────┼─────┘             │
         ▼                   ▼
       Async I/O ──────── RPC Runtime
         │
   ┌─────┼───────────┐
   ▼     ▼           ▼
io_uring IOCP     epoll/kqueue
   │     │           │
   └─────┼───────────┘
         ▼
     OS / NIC / DMA
```

Điểm quan trọng nhất của 202 là Axiom hiện có thể biểu diễn một đường **zero-copy end-to-end**:

```text
NIC
 ↓
DMA Buffer
 ↓
NetworkBuffer
 ↓
Protocol View
 ↓
Application View
 ↓
Tensor / Audio / Video
```

mà không bắt programmer phải tự viết một chuỗi lifetime annotation.

Compiler có thể tự xác minh:

```text
Who owns the buffer?
Who may read it?
Who may mutate it?
How long must it remain valid?
Which async operation depends on it?
Can it be moved?
Can it be reused?
Can it be freed?
```

Đây chính là nơi mô hình **ownership + capability + async + storage domain** của Axiom bắt đầu cho thấy lợi thế rõ rệt so với việc thiết kế từng subsystem độc lập.

# 203.100. Storage invariants — `ASTORE`

### `ASTORE-20`
Filesystem, file and database functionality shall remain library/system layers.

### `ASTORE-21`
OS file handles shall not be treated as arbitrary integers in safe APIs.

### `ASTORE-22`
File ownership shall obey Axiom resource semantics.

### `ASTORE-23`
Memory mappings shall have explicit ownership and lifetime.

### `ASTORE-24`
Mapped views shall not outlive their mapping.

### `ASTORE-25`
Writable mappings shall obey normal mutable capability rules.

### `ASTORE-26`
Persistent representation shall remain distinct from ordinary memory representation.

### `ASTORE-27`
Persistent formats shall not rely on raw process pointers as identity.

### `ASTORE-28`
Persistent references shall use validated logical identifiers or offsets.

### `ASTORE-29`
Database pages shall have explicit identity and validity semantics.

### `ASTORE-30`
Pinned pages shall remain valid for the duration of dependent capabilities.

### `ASTORE-31`
Buffer eviction shall not invalidate live safe capabilities.

### `ASTORE-32`
Async storage operations shall preserve buffer lifetime until completion.

### `ASTORE-33`
Direct I/O shall respect alignment and storage contracts.

### `ASTORE-34`
WAL semantics shall distinguish written, flushed and durable states.

### `ASTORE-35`
Transaction state transitions shall be explicit.

### `ASTORE-36`
Dropping an active transaction shall not silently mean commit.

### `ASTORE-37`
Crash recovery shall not expose partially published storage state.

### `ASTORE-38`
Storage publication shall be atomic according to the selected filesystem/storage contract.

### `ASTORE-39`
Recovery shall distinguish corruption/failure from language panic.

### `ASTORE-40`
Checksum/integrity metadata shall be validated before trusted exposure.

### `ASTORE-41`
B-tree/LSM structures shall use explicit persistent representation contracts.

### `ASTORE-42`
In-memory layout and persistent layout shall not be conflated.

### `ASTORE-43`
Compaction shall preserve source resource lifetimes until completion.

### `ASTORE-44`
Cancelled storage operations shall not publish incomplete persistent artifacts.

### `ASTORE-45`
MVCC snapshots shall use logical validity rather than physical addresses.

### `ASTORE-46`
Row/page handles shall not depend on stable memory addresses.

### `ASTORE-47`
Connection/transaction/statement dependencies shall preserve resource lifetime.

### `ASTORE-48`
Database pools shall not return resources while dependent operations remain live.

### `ASTORE-49`
Database concurrency shall reuse Axiom synchronization semantics.

### `ASTORE-50`
Async database operations shall obey Axiom async suspension rules.

### `ASTORE-51`
Database deadlock/retry behavior shall remain library-level policy.

### `ASTORE-52`
Columnar/vectorized execution may use Axiom SIMD and tensor facilities.

### `ASTORE-53`
Vector indexes may reuse Axiom SIMD/tensor/GPU infrastructure.

### `ASTORE-54`
Database-to-tensor conversion may be zero-copy when layout and ownership permit.

### `ASTORE-55`
Cache views shall remain valid for their declared capability lifetime.

### `ASTORE-56`
Eviction shall not invalidate live safe capabilities.

### `ASTORE-57`
Schema fingerprints shall remain distinct from ABI fingerprints.

### `ASTORE-58`
Schema migrations shall be explicit executable transformations.

### `ASTORE-59`
Generated schema/serialization code shall pass normal Axiom verification.

### `ASTORE-60`
Storage unsafe code shall establish explicit validity contracts before exposing safe values.

### `ASTORE-61`
Storage systems shall support deterministic and reproducible tests where applicable.

### `ASTORE-62`
Crash testing shall be part of storage-engine correctness validation.

### `ASTORE-63`
Persistent artifacts shall have explicit format/version identity.

### `ASTORE-64`
Database runtimes shall be optional.

### `ASTORE-65`
Programs not using persistent storage shall not acquire storage runtime components.

### `ASTORE-66`
Storage engines shall not require a garbage collector.

### `ASTORE-67`
Storage engines shall support native async I/O without forcing thread-per-operation.

### `ASTORE-68`
Storage optimization shall preserve crash, ownership and concurrency semantics.

### `ASTORE-69`
AI/compiler tooling shall expose storage ownership, async, allocation and capability facts.

### `ASTORE-70`
Axiom shall support construction of native storage engines without requiring a separate memory-management model.

```text id="w3j9kr"

                            │
              ┌─────────────┼─────────────┐
              │             │             │

              │             │
```


Điều này phù hợp hoàn toàn với quyết định trước đó của Axiom về **Value Identity / Storage Identity / Logical Identity**.

# BOOTSTRAP-204 — Distributed Storage, Consensus, Actors & Fault-Tolerant Systems

**TRẠNG THÁI: NEXT**

Sau 203, tầng local storage đã đủ nền. Bước tiếp theo nên khóa **distributed systems**, vì đây là nơi các mô hình ownership/concurrency/async/network/storage của Axiom phải hội tụ.

Phạm vi:

```text
Distributed Node
       │
       ├── Membership
       ├── Failure Detection
       ├── Leader Election
       ├── Consensus
       │     ├── Raft
       │     └── Paxos-like
       │
       ├── Replication
       ├── Sharding
       ├── Consistent Hashing
       ├── Distributed Transaction
       ├── WAL Replication
       ├── Event Log
       ├── Actor
       ├── Supervision
       ├── Cluster
       └── Fault Injection
```

Đặc biệt cần giải quyết một câu hỏi kiến trúc lớn:

> **Axiom có thể dùng ownership + message passing để xây distributed systems mạnh đến mức nào mà không cần biến Actor/Cluster/Distributed Object thành primitive của ngôn ngữ?**

Và cần chốt quan hệ:

```text
Axiom Ownership
       ↓
Local Channel
       ↓
Network RPC
       ↓
Actor Mailbox
       ↓
Replication Log
       ↓
Consensus
       ↓
Distributed State
```

Mục tiêu là giữ nguyên nguyên tắc xuyên suốt:

**Core càng ổn định và nhỏ, nhưng compiler hiểu càng sâu; mọi abstraction cấp cao — kể cả distributed systems — vẫn được xây trên cùng một ownership/capability/concurrency model.**
tiếp tục

# BOOTSTRAP-204 — Distributed Systems, Consensus, Actors & Fault-Tolerant Computing

**TRẠNG THÁI: FROZEN / COMPLETED**

Mục tiêu của 204 là hoàn thiện tầng distributed systems mà **không làm phình Core language**.

Nguyên tắc trung tâm:

> **Distributed computing là sự mở rộng của Ownership + Message Passing + Async + Network + Storage + Failure Semantics, không phải một memory model mới.**

Axiom không cần:

- `actor` keyword bắt buộc
- distributed object primitive
- remote pointer
- distributed GC
- transparent remote function call
- distributed shared memory giả lập như local memory

---

# 204.1. Distributed system model

Một hệ thống Axiom phân tán được mô hình hóa:

```text
                    Cluster
                       │
        ┌──────────────┼──────────────┐
        ▼              ▼              ▼
      Node A         Node B         Node C
        │              │              │
     Process        Process        Process
        │              │              │
      Task           Task           Task
        │              │              │
     Actor          Actor          Actor
```

Mỗi node là một **failure domain** riêng.

---

# 204.2. Node identity

Node có logical identity:

```text
NodeId
```

Không dùng IP address làm identity.

Vì:

```text
IP ≠ process identity ≠ node identity
```

Đã có:


```text
NodeId
ProcessId
```

```text
ProcessRef = (NodeId, ProcessId)
```


Không phải:


```text

 ├── State
```

# 204.6. Actor message


gửi remote:

```text
→ deserialize
```

```text

failure
retry
partial execution

remote crash
```

# 204.18. Không giữ sync lock qua await

---

# 204.67. Epoch

Epoch/term có thể bảo vệ resource ownership logic:

```text
old epoch
```

không được overwrite:

```text
new epoch
```

---

# 204.68. Distributed resource ownership

Cần phân biệt:

```text
Axiom Ownership
```

và:

```text
Distributed Lease Ownership
```

---

# 204.69. Distributed handles

Handle:

```text
RemoteHandle<T>
```

không đảm bảo remote object tồn tại.

```text
NotFound
Unavailable
Stale
EpochMismatch
```

---

# 204.70. No distributed GC

```text
lease
reference protocol
ownership message
explicit close
```

# 204.71. Distributed reference counting

```text
RemoteLease
```

# 204.72. Failure-aware Drop

# 204.73. Network failure khi Drop

có thể trả:

```text
Result<(), Error>
```

# 204.75. Distributed async

```text
Future
await

Deadline
Send
```

```text
exponential backoff
jitter
max attempts
deadline
idempotency
```

Nếu request chứa owned value:

```text
Request
```

Không dựa vào hash-map iteration order ngẫu nhiên.

```text
UnknownFields
```

```text
features
capabilities
```

# 204.100. Distributed invariants — `ADIST`

### `ADIST-20`
Distributed systems shall remain library/framework abstractions above Core semantics.

### `ADIST-21`
Node identity shall be distinct from network address.

### `ADIST-22`
Process identity shall be distinct from memory identity.

### `ADIST-23`
Actor identity shall be logical identity, not physical address.

### `ADIST-24`
Actors shall not require inheritance or a special object model.

### `ADIST-25`
Actor state shall have explicit ownership.

### `ADIST-26`
Actor messages shall obey normal ownership semantics.

### `ADIST-27`
Network serialization shall be explicit.

### `ADIST-28`
Axiom `Send` shall not imply network serializability.

### `ADIST-29`
Remote references shall never masquerade as local safe references.

### `ADIST-30`
Remote operations shall expose failure semantics.

### `ADIST-31`
Distributed ownership shall remain distinct from Axiom memory ownership.

### `ADIST-32`
Distributed leases shall not be represented as ordinary memory ownership.

### `ADIST-33`
Failure detectors shall represent suspicion rather than absolute proof of failure.

### `ADIST-34`
Distributed systems shall not assume perfectly synchronized clocks.

### `ADIST-35`
Logical clocks shall remain distinct from wall-clock time.

### `ADIST-36`
Consensus shall remain a library-level protocol.

### `ADIST-37`
Consensus logs shall distinguish appended, committed and applied state.

### `ADIST-38`
Consensus persistence shall use the storage guarantees defined by the storage layer.

### `ADIST-39`
Consensus snapshots shall be atomically published according to storage contracts.

### `ADIST-40`
Network partitions shall not violate Axiom memory safety.

### `ADIST-41`
Distributed consistency semantics shall be explicit.

### `ADIST-42`
Exactly-once execution shall not be assumed by default.

### `ADIST-43`
Retry shall be explicit policy.

### `ADIST-44`
Retry shall not implicitly clone non-Copy values.

### `ADIST-45`
Idempotency shall be explicit when required for safe retry.

### `ADIST-46`
Distributed transactions shall remain library-level abstractions.

### `ADIST-47`
Saga compensation shall be explicit.

### `ADIST-48`
Transactional outbox semantics shall compose with the storage layer.

### `ADIST-49`
Distributed locks shall not be treated as equivalent to local Mutexes.

### `ADIST-50`
Lease expiration shall not rely on unsafe assumptions about wall-clock synchronization.

### `ADIST-51`
Fencing tokens shall be supported where stale writers must be prevented.

### `ADIST-52`
Distributed resource cleanup shall not depend on reliable network communication during Drop.

### `ADIST-53`
Fallible remote cleanup shall use explicit operations.

### `ADIST-54`
Distributed async operations shall reuse Axiom Future semantics.

### `ADIST-55`
Cancellation shall remain distinct from remote process termination.

### `ADIST-56`
RPC version negotiation shall be explicit.

### `ADIST-57`
Rolling deployments shall support explicit protocol compatibility.

### `ADIST-58`
Remote feature capabilities shall be runtime protocol facts, not compile-time assumptions.

### `ADIST-59`
Authentication shall remain distinct from logical node identity.

### `ADIST-60`
Authorization shall remain distinct from language ownership.

### `ADIST-61`
Distributed secrets shall obey explicit ownership and sensitive-data policies.

### `ADIST-62`
Distributed tracing context shall be explicit transferable data.

### `ADIST-63`
Distributed logging shall support structured events.

### `ADIST-64`
Distributed systems shall provide deterministic testing facilities.

### `ADIST-65`
Network, storage, process and node fault injection shall be supported by testing infrastructure.

### `ADIST-66`
Consensus implementations shall be subject to adversarial protocol testing.

### `ADIST-67`
Distributed data structures shall support model-based and history-based testing where applicable.

### `ADIST-68`
Generated RPC/distributed code shall pass normal Axiom verification.

### `ADIST-69`
Distributed abstractions shall not require garbage collection.

### `ADIST-70`
Distributed abstractions shall not require distributed GC.

### `ADIST-71`
Distributed abstractions shall not introduce remote pointers into Core.

### `ADIST-72`
Distributed abstractions shall compose with Axiom ownership, capability, async, network and storage models.

# Một quyết định rất quan trọng được khóa

Axiom **không** cố biến distributed programming thành:

```axiom
remote_object.do_something()
```

và giả vờ nó giống:

```axiom
local_object.do_something()
```

Thay vào đó:

```text
LOCAL
  └── function call

ASYNC LOCAL
  └── Future

NETWORK
  └── RPC / message

DISTRIBUTED
  └── RPC + failure + consistency contract
```

Điều này giữ cho ngôn ngữ **đơn giản nhưng không đánh lừa programmer về semantics**.

Mục tiêu:

> **Axiom phải có mô hình thời gian chính xác, hiệu năng cao và không gây nhầm lẫn giữa đo thời gian, lịch thực thi, timeout, wall-clock, logical time và distributed time.**

# 205.1. Không có một `Time` duy nhất

Axiom phân biệt:

```text
Instant
Duration
Deadline
WallClock
MonotonicClock
LogicalClock
VirtualClock
```

Không cho phép trộn chúng tùy tiện.

---

# 205.2. `Duration`

`Duration` là khoảng thời gian:

```axiom
Duration
```

Ví dụ:

```axiom
10.ms
2.s
500.us
```

Nó không biểu diễn một thời điểm.

---

# 205.3. `Instant`

`Instant` là một điểm trên một monotonic timeline.

```axiom
Instant
```

Phép toán hợp lệ:

```text
Instant + Duration → Instant
Instant - Duration → Instant
Instant - Instant → Duration
```

Không cho:

```text
Instant + Instant
```

---

# 205.4. Monotonic clock

Clock dùng cho:

- timeout
- benchmark
- scheduling
- latency
- elapsed time

phải là monotonic.

```text
t2 >= t1
```

theo cùng clock domain.

---

# 205.5. Wall clock

Wall clock biểu diễn thời gian lịch:

```text
DateTime
```

Có thể thay đổi bởi:

- NTP
- user adjustment
- timezone
- daylight saving
- OS correction

Không dùng wall clock để đo elapsed duration.

---

# 205.6. Không implicit conversion

Không cho:

```text
WallTime → Instant
```

hoặc ngược lại nếu không có clock context.

---

# 205.7. Date và time-of-day

Phân biệt:

```text
Date
TimeOfDay
DateTime
Duration
Instant
```

---

# 205.8. Time zone

Timezone là dữ liệu/phần library:

```text
TimeZone
```

Không đưa timezone database vào Core.

---

# 205.9. UTC

UTC là một representation/standard time scale.

Không đồng nhất:

```text
UTC timestamp
```

với:

```text
monotonic Instant
```

---

# 205.10. Leap seconds

Calendar/time library phải xử lý leap-second policy explicit.

Monotonic scheduler không phụ thuộc calendar semantics.

---

# 205.11. Deadline

`Deadline` biểu diễn thời điểm hết hạn:

```text
Deadline
```

Thường được xây từ:

```text
Instant + Duration
```

# 205.12. Timeout

Timeout là policy:

```text
timeout = 500.ms
```

Deadline là state:

```text
deadline = ...
```

Có thể chuyển:

```text
Timeout → Deadline
```

tại một thời điểm cụ thể.

---

# 205.13. Timeout propagation

RPC/request context nên truyền:

```text
Deadline
```

thay vì mỗi tầng tự cộng thêm timeout.

```text
Client deadline
      ↓
RPC
      ↓
Database
      ↓
Storage
```

# 205.14. Remaining time

API:

```text
deadline.remaining()
```

trả:

```text
Duration
```

hoặc zero/expired state.

---

# 205.15. Cancellation và timeout

Hai khái niệm khác nhau:

```text
Cancellation
Timeout
```

Timeout có thể **gây ra** cancellation nhưng không đồng nghĩa với cancellation.

---

# 205.16. Sleep

```text
sleep(duration)
```

là scheduler operation.

Không đảm bảo thread thức dậy chính xác sau đúng duration.

Nó chỉ đảm bảo:

```text
not before requested wake condition
```

trong phạm vi scheduler/OS semantics.

---

# 205.17. Sleep accuracy

Độ chính xác phụ thuộc:

- OS
- timer resolution
- scheduler
- power state
- CPU load

Không đưa accuracy giả tạo vào Core.

---

# 205.18. Yield

```text
yield()
```

nhường execution opportunity.

Không đảm bảo task/thread khác chắc chắn được chạy.

# 205.19. Timer

Timer là resource/scheduler object:

```text
Timer
```

có thể:

```text
one-shot
periodic
deadline-based
```

# 205.20. One-shot timer

```text
Timer.after(100.ms)
```

phát một completion/event.

---

```text
Timer.every(1.s)
```

nhưng phải định nghĩa drift policy.

# 205.22. Periodic scheduling

Có hai semantics:

```text
fixed-delay
fixed-rate
```

### Fixed delay

```text
execute
 ↓
wait 1s
 ↓
execute
```

### Fixed rate

```text
T0
T1 = T0 + 1s
T2 = T0 + 2s
...
```

Axiom phải phân biệt.

# 205.23. Timer drift

Timer periodic không được mặc định cộng:

```text
now + period
```

nếu muốn fixed-rate.

```text
next_deadline += period
```

# 205.24. Missed ticks

Nếu task chạy quá lâu:

```text
T0
task = 3s
period = 1s
```

```text
Skip
CatchUp
Coalesce
Delay
```

Không implicit chọn semantics cho application.

# 205.25. Timer cancellation

Timer có ownership.

```text

```

hoặc Drop có thể cancel theo contract.

Không được để callback chạy sau khi lifetime contract đã kết thúc.

---

# 205.26. Timer callback lifetime

Callback phải giữ mọi captured values sống đủ lâu.

Compiler ownership analysis áp dụng bình thường.

---

# 205.27. Timer callback + async

Timer có thể trả:

```text
Future
```

thay vì callback.

Đây là abstraction phù hợp với Axiom async model.

# 205.28. Timer wheel

Runtime có thể dùng:

```text
TimerWheel
```

để giảm chi phí quản lý hàng triệu timers.

Implementation detail, không phải language semantic.

---

# 205.29. Priority queue timers

Scheduler có thể dùng:

```text
min-heap
calendar queue
timer wheel
hierarchical wheel
```

tùy workload.

---

# 205.30. Scheduler

Scheduler là library/runtime component:

```text
Scheduler
```

Không phải Core primitive.

---

# 205.31. Scheduler responsibilities

Scheduler quyết định:

```text
which task runs
when it runs
where it runs
```

nhưng không thay đổi semantic ownership.

---

# 205.32. Task

Task là execution unit:


đã có từ async model.

```text
Ready
Running
Waiting
Completed
Cancelled
Failed
```

# 205.33. Scheduler queue

```text
Task
 ↓ move
SchedulerQueue
```

```text
Worker B
```

# 205.35. Pinned task

# 205.36. Worker pool

Runtime có thể:

```text
N workers
M tasks
```

với work stealing.

# 205.37. Work stealing

Task chỉ được steal nếu execution contract cho phép.

# 205.38. CPU affinity

```text
local node
preferred node
interleaved
replicated
```

nhưng storage policy không thay đổi ownership semantics.

# 205.41. Priority

```text
Priority
```

```text
RealTime
```

```text
statistics
outlier handling
```

```text
saturating
wrapping
```

theo numeric model.

# 205.75. Timer resource ownership

```text
future callback
```

không được giữ dangling captures.

```text
TraceContext
```

để network/storage/actor layers cùng sử dụng.

Child operation mặc định nhận:

```text
FIFO
priority
fair
work-stealing
deadline
```

theo policy.

Fairness/starvation là scheduler contract.

Không phải compiler correctness invariant.

# 205.80. Priority starvation

Nếu priority scheduler có thể starve low-priority tasks, runtime phải document semantics.

# 205.81. Timer storm

Runtime nên có protection/policy cho hàng triệu timers:

```text
coalescing
timer wheel
batch wakeup
```

nhưng không thay đổi requested semantic deadlines.

# 205.82. Power-aware timers

Mobile/embedded runtime có thể coalesce timers để tiết kiệm năng lượng.

# 205.83. High-resolution timing

# 205.84. Time resolution

```text
representation resolution
clock resolution
measurement accuracy
scheduler resolution
```

Không đánh đồng chúng.

```text
Interrupt
```

- không allocation nếu profile cấm
- execution bounded
- synchronization đặc biệt

# 205.86. Interrupt-safe code

```text
no blocking
no forbidden allocation
no async
no unsafe external operations
```

theo target.

# 205.87. Signal execution

# 205.88. Temporal effects

Effect system có thể bổ sung:

```text
Blocking
TimingSensitive
RealtimeUnsafe
```

nhưng chỉ khi compiler cần cho profile/tooling.

```text
ax explain scheduling
ax explain blocking
ax explain realtime
```

```text
  File.read()
    → OS I/O
    → Blocking
```

# 205.90. Async diagnostics

Compiler có thể chỉ:

```text
Value X lives across await
X is not Send
Task cannot migrate
```

đã phù hợp với async verification.

# 205.91. Temporal ownership

Không tạo lifetime kiểu:

```text
'1
'2
```

cho time.

Temporal validity được biểu diễn qua:

```text
Deadline
Cancellation
Capability
Task lifetime
Resource lifetime
```

# 205.92. Timer + resource lifetime

Ví dụ conceptual:

```axiom
let timer = Timer.after(5.s, callback)
```

Compiler/runtime phải đảm bảo callback environment sống đến khi timer hoàn tất/cancel.

# 205.93. Scheduler + Drop

Task completion phải chạy cleanup đúng ownership semantics.

Nếu task cancelled:

```text
state fields
```

được Drop đúng quy tắc.

---

# 205.94. Scheduler + panic

Panic của một task:

```text
TaskFailed
```

không mặc định kill toàn process nếu runtime profile không yêu cầu.

Structured concurrency có thể propagate failure tới parent.

---

# 205.95. Scheduler + shutdown

Runtime shutdown phải có thứ tự:

```text
stop accepting work
 ↓
cancel/complete tasks according to policy
 ↓
drain events
 ↓
close resources
 ↓
thread shutdown
 ↓
process exit
```

---

# 205.96. Process exit

Phân biệt:

```text
return from main
process_exit
abort
panic
```

đã có runtime model.

Time/scheduler không được giữ process sống vô hạn nếu không còn required runtime work.

---

# 205.97. Sleep in freestanding

Freestanding profile có thể không có clock/timer.

API không tồn tại nếu target capability không hỗ trợ.

---

# 205.98. Embedded time

Embedded target có thể cung cấp:

```text
HardwareTimer
RTC
CycleCounter
```

qua platform/system layer.

Standard library nên có trait tương tự:

# 205.100. Temporal invariants — `ATIME`

### `ATIME-20`
`Duration`, `Instant`, `Deadline`, wall time and logical time shall remain distinct semantic types.

### `ATIME-21`
Monotonic time shall be used for elapsed-time measurement and timeout semantics.

### `ATIME-22`
Wall-clock time shall not be used as a monotonic elapsed-time source.

### `ATIME-23`
No implicit conversion shall exist between unrelated clock domains.

### `ATIME-24`
`Instant - Instant` shall produce a duration within the same clock domain.

### `ATIME-25`
`Instant + Duration` shall produce an instant in the same clock domain.

### `ATIME-26`
Deadline semantics shall be explicit.

### `ATIME-27`
Timeout shall remain distinct from cancellation.

### `ATIME-28`
Sleep shall not promise exact wakeup timing beyond its declared scheduler/platform contract.

### `ATIME-29`
Periodic timers shall explicitly define fixed-rate or fixed-delay semantics.

### `ATIME-30`
Periodic timer drift policy shall be explicit.

### `ATIME-31`
Missed periodic ticks shall obey an explicit policy.

### `ATIME-32`
Timer cancellation shall preserve callback/resource lifetime safety.

### `ATIME-33`
Timer callbacks shall not outlive captured resources.

### `ATIME-34`
Scheduler queues shall own queued tasks according to normal ownership semantics.

### `ATIME-35`
Task migration shall require the appropriate `Send` guarantees.

### `ATIME-36`
Pinned execution shall remain an execution/storage contract rather than a new Core pointer model.

### `ATIME-37`
Scheduler policy shall remain separate from language semantics.

### `ATIME-38`
Priority shall not imply a universal execution guarantee.

### `ATIME-39`
Real-time guarantees shall be profile/platform/application contracts.

### `ATIME-40`
Real-time profiles may prohibit unbounded allocation, blocking or synchronization.

### `ATIME-41`
Blocking operations shall remain visible to the effect/tooling system where relevant.

### `ATIME-42`
Async code shall not silently acquire hidden blocking semantics.

### `ATIME-43`
Event loops shall reuse Axiom async/task semantics.

### `ATIME-44`
Game fixed-timestep scheduling shall remain distinct from rendering frame timing.

### `ATIME-45`
Audio clocks shall remain distinct from CPU wall/monotonic clocks.

### `ATIME-46`
GPU timestamps shall remain distinct from CPU timestamps unless explicitly calibrated.

### `ATIME-47`
Comptime time access shall require explicit capability.

### `ATIME-48`
Comptime time inputs shall participate in build identity.

### `ATIME-49`
Reproducible builds shall control or prohibit nondeterministic time inputs.

### `ATIME-50`
Virtual clocks shall be supported for deterministic testing.

### `ATIME-51`
Deterministic schedulers shall be supported for concurrency testing.

### `ATIME-52`
Logical clocks shall remain distinct from physical time.

### `ATIME-53`
Distributed clock synchronization shall not be assumed perfect.

### `ATIME-54`
Clock conversion shall require an explicit calibration/contract.

### `ATIME-55`
Timestamp arithmetic shall have defined overflow behavior.

### `ATIME-56`
Interrupt execution shall remain a distinct execution domain.

### `ATIME-57`
Interrupt handlers shall obey target-specific safety and blocking restrictions.

### `ATIME-58`
Signal execution shall respect platform signal-safety constraints.

### `ATIME-59`
Temporal behavior shall not introduce a separate ownership/lifetime system.

### `ATIME-60`
Task cancellation shall execute normal ownership cleanup.

### `ATIME-61`
Task failure shall remain distinct from process failure unless runtime policy propagates it.

### `ATIME-62`
Scheduler shutdown shall have explicit task/resource shutdown semantics.

### `ATIME-63`
Freestanding targets need not provide a wall clock or scheduler.

### `ATIME-64`
Hardware timers shall remain platform/system abstractions.

### `ATIME-65`
Time sources shall be injectable for deterministic testing.

### `ATIME-66`
Temporal APIs shall not require garbage collection.

### `ATIME-67`
Temporal APIs shall not require a monolithic runtime.

### `ATIME-68`
Timer and scheduler implementations shall be free to optimize representation without changing temporal semantics.

### `ATIME-69`
Compiler diagnostics shall expose relevant blocking, deadline, task migration and real-time restrictions.

### `ATIME-70`
Time semantics shall remain consistent across CPU, GPU, async, GUI, networking, storage and distributed layers.

```text
acknowledged
```

# 206.34. DNS cache

Cache là library/storage abstraction.

Không đưa global DNS cache vào runtime bắt buộc.

---

# 206.35. HTTP layer

HTTP:

```text
HttpRequest
HttpResponse
Headers
Body
```

là library types.

---

# 206.36. HTTP body streaming

Không bắt buộc:

```text
Body = Vec<u8>
```

Có thể:

```text
BodyStream
```

để xử lý file/large payload mà không load toàn bộ RAM.

---

# 206.37. HTTP request body ownership

Request body có thể là:

```text
OwnedBuffer
Stream
File
Generator
```

nhưng semantics ownership phải rõ.

---

# 206.38. HTTP response body

Response có thể:

```text
return buffer
return stream
return file-backed stream
```

Compiler không ép materialize toàn bộ response.

---

# 206.39. HTTP/1.1

Hỗ trợ:

- persistent connections
- pipelining theo compatibility requirements
- chunked transfer
- compression
- trailers

ở library level.

---

# 206.40. HTTP/2

HTTP/2 cần multiplex:

```text
Connection
 ├── Stream A
 ├── Stream B
 └── Stream C
```

và flow control.

---

# 206.41. HTTP/3

HTTP/3 chạy trên:

```text
HTTP/3
 ↓
QUIC
 ↓
UDP
```

Không cần một HTTP-specific transport primitive trong Core.

---

# 206.42. WebSocket

WebSocket:

```text
HttpUpgrade
 ↓
WebSocket
```

có message framing.

---

# 206.43. WebSocket message

Phân biệt:

```text
TextMessage
BinaryMessage
Ping
Pong
Close
```

---

# 206.44. RPC

RPC layer xây trên transport:

```text
RPC
 ├── HTTP/2
 ├── HTTP/3
 ├── TCP
 ├── QUIC
 └── custom transport
```

Không hard-code HTTP.

---

# 206.45. RPC streaming

Đã có:

```text
Unary
ServerStream
ClientStream
BidirectionalStream
```

và 206 khóa implementation dưới transport.

---

# 206.46. Serialization

Serialization không được đồng nhất với memory layout.

```text
Memory Layout
    ≠
Wire Format
```

---

# 206.47. Endianness

Wire protocol phải chỉ rõ:

```text
BigEndian
LittleEndian
NetworkOrder
Custom
```

Không lấy native machine endian làm protocol semantics.

---

# 206.48. Zero-copy serialization

Nếu wire representation tương thích layout, compiler/library có thể tránh copy.

Nhưng:

```text
@repr(C)
```

không tự động có nghĩa:

```text
WireSafe
```

---

# 206.49. Network input validation

Dữ liệu từ network là untrusted.

Pipeline:

```text
bytes
 ↓
parse
 ↓
validate
 ↓
typed value
```

Không được tạo safe typed value từ bytes chưa kiểm tra.

---

# 206.50. Parser zero-copy

Parser có thể trả:

```text
view<u8>
Str
```

nếu backing buffer còn sống.

Đây là nơi Axiom capability model tạo lợi thế lớn.

---

# 206.51. Parser lifetime

Không cần programmer viết lifetime annotation.

Compiler biết:

```text
ParsedMessage
 └── view
      └── InputBuffer
```

và reject nếu view escape khỏi buffer.

---

# 206.52. Streaming parser

Parser có thể incremental:

```text
chunk
 ↓
state machine
 ↓
message
```

không cần concatenate toàn bộ input.

---

# 206.53. Backpressure

Pipeline:

```text
NIC
 ↓
Socket
 ↓
Parser
 ↓
Application
```

phải hỗ trợ backpressure.

Không tự động buffer vô hạn.

---

# 206.54. Bounded network buffers

Mặc định high-performance server nên ưu tiên:

```text
bounded buffer pool
```

để kiểm soát memory.

---

# 206.55. Buffer pool

```text
NetworkBufferPool
```

có thể tái sử dụng buffers.

Ownership:

```text
pool
 ↓ checkout
buffer
 ↓ completion
pool
```

---

# 206.56. DMA buffer

DMA-capable buffer là storage contract:

```text
DmaBuffer<T>
```

có alignment/lifetime constraints.

---

# 206.57. DMA ownership

Trong lúc NIC đang sử dụng buffer:

```text
CPU mutable access
```

không được đồng thời tồn tại nếu hardware contract cấm.

Đây là capability conflict, không phải GC problem.

---

# 206.58. Completion

I/O completion:

```text
Pending
Ready
Failed
Cancelled
```

đã thống nhất với async model.

---

# 206.59. Completion ownership

Một pending operation giữ các resources cần thiết cho tới khi completion/cancellation contract hoàn tất.

---

# 206.60. Cancellation race

Nếu:

```text
cancel()
```

xảy ra đồng thời với kernel completion, API phải có trạng thái xác định:

```text
Completed
CancelledBeforeStart
CancelledAfterSubmission
CompletionWon
```

không được tạo dangling buffer.

---

# 206.61. io_uring

Linux backend:

```text
io_uring
```

là implementation của async I/O interface.

Không leak Linux-specific semantics vào Core.

---

# 206.62. IOCP

Windows:

```text
IOCP
```

cùng semantic interface.

---

# 206.63. epoll

epoll có thể làm readiness backend.

Không giả định readiness = completion.

---

# 206.64. kqueue

macOS/BSD backend:

```text
kqueue
```

---

# 206.65. Readiness vs Completion

Đây là khác biệt quan trọng:

```text
Readiness:
"operation can probably proceed"

Completion:
"operation has completed"
```

Axiom I/O layer phải giữ distinction.

---

# 206.66. Async network abstraction

High-level API có thể thống nhất:

```axiom
async fn read(...)
async fn write(...)
```

nhưng backend tự chọn:

```text
io_uring
IOCP
epoll
kqueue
```

---

# 206.67. Blocking network API

Axiom cũng cho phép:

```text
blocking read
blocking write
```

trong synchronous programs.

Không bắt mọi chương trình phải async.

---

# 206.68. Async ≠ faster

Async là execution model.

Performance phụ thuộc:

```text
syscalls
copies
allocations
context switches
cache locality
NIC
protocol
scheduler
```

---

# 206.69. Connection pool

High-level client:

```text
ConnectionPool<T>
```

quản lý:

- idle connections
- max connections
- lifetime
- health
- timeout

---

# 206.70. Pool ownership

Checkout:

```text
Pool
 ↓
ConnectionLease
```

Lease Drop có thể trả connection về pool theo contract.

Nhưng network close/failure vẫn phải được xử lý rõ.

---

# 206.71. Connection reuse

HTTP keep-alive/HTTP2 multiplex/QUIC connection reuse phải do protocol layer quản lý.

Không gộp thành một generic magic.

---

# 206.72. Rate limiting

Network library có:

```text
TokenBucket
LeakyBucket
ConcurrencyLimit
```

---

# 206.73. Rate limiting không phải backpressure

```text
RateLimit
    ≠
Backpressure
    ≠
ConcurrencyLimit
```

---

# 206.74. Retry

Retry policy:

```text
RetryPolicy
```

phải xét:

```text
idempotency
deadline
connection state
partial write
server response
```

---

# 206.75. Partial write

TCP write có thể ghi ít bytes hơn yêu cầu.

API phải biểu diễn:

```text
written_bytes
```

hoặc cung cấp `write_all` explicit.

---

# 206.76. `write_all`

`write_all` là loop abstraction:

```text
while remaining:
    write(...)
```

Compiler có thể inline/eliminate abstraction overhead.

---

# 206.77. Scatter/gather optimization

Compiler/backend có thể giữ nhiều views thành một vectored operation thay vì merge buffers.

---

# 206.78. Sendfile/splice

System layer có thể hỗ trợ:

```text
sendfile
splice
copy_file_range
```

khi platform cho phép.

Mục tiêu:

```text
disk
 ↓
kernel
 ↓
NIC
```

thay vì:

```text
disk
 ↓
user memory
 ↓
kernel
 ↓
NIC
```

---

# 206.79. Kernel bypass

System library có thể hỗ trợ:

```text
DPDK
AF_XDP
io_uring zero-copy
RDMA
```

nhưng tất cả đều cần explicit unsafe/system contracts.

---

# 206.80. RDMA

RDMA layer:

```text
MemoryRegion
QueuePair
CompletionQueue
```

---

# 206.81. RDMA memory registration

Registered memory có lifetime constraint:

```text
registered
 ↓
NIC may access
 ↓
deregister
```

Compiler/resource model phải ngăn deregister khi operation còn pending.

---

# 206.82. RDMA completion

Memory không được tái sử dụng trước khi required completion.

Đây là một trường hợp rất mạnh để kiểm chứng ownership + async model.

---

# 206.83. Network execution domain

Có thể có:

```text
CPU
NIC
DMA
GPU
```

nhưng NIC/DMA không phải general-purpose Axiom execution domain.

Chúng là external execution agents.

---

# 206.84. External agent capability

Khi hardware có quyền đọc/write buffer:

```text
CPU capability
```

phải không conflict với:

```text
DMA capability
```

theo device contract.

---

# 206.85. Network security

Các layer:

```text
TLS
DTLS
IPsec
MACsec
```

là security libraries/system layers.

---

# 206.86. Certificate types

Certificate/key/signature nên là typed structures, không phải raw byte arrays trong high-level API.

---

# 206.87. Secret memory

Sensitive buffers có thể có policy:

```text
NoDump
ZeroOnDrop
LockedMemory
```

nếu platform hỗ trợ.

Không đảm bảo tuyệt đối trên mọi OS.

---

# 206.88. Memory zeroing

Compiler không được optimize away required security zeroing.

Phải có semantic `SecureZero`/volatile-like primitive.

---

# 206.89. Network effects

Network operations có effects:

```text
IO
Network
Allocate
Synchronize
Foreign
```

và compiler/tooling có thể truy vấn.

---

# 206.90. Network capability

Không phải function nào cũng cần quyền network.

Application/security layer có thể giới hạn:

```text
DNS
TCP
UDP
RawSocket
RDMA
```

---

# 206.91. Raw sockets

Raw socket API nằm ở unsafe/system layer.

Không cấp quyền raw packet manipulation cho safe high-level socket API.

---

# 206.92. Packet capture

Packet capture:

```text
Pcap
AF_PACKET
BPF
```

là system capability.

---

# 206.93. Firewall integration

Firewall/network policy là OS/security layer.

Không phải compiler semantics.

---

# 206.94. Network namespaces

Linux/network namespace:

```text
NetworkNamespace
```

là OS resource.

---

# 206.95. Virtual networking

Support abstraction cho:

```text
veth
TUN/TAP
virtual NIC
```

ở system layer.

---

# 206.96. WASM networking

WASM có thể không có raw socket.

Network capability thông qua host imports/platform environment.

Core semantics không thay đổi.

---

# 206.97. Freestanding networking

Freestanding target có thể không có network.

API capability không tồn tại hoặc không được link.

---

# 206.98. AI/compiler integration

CompilerDB có thể expose:

```text
ax inspect network-buffer
ax explain async-io
ax explain zero-copy
ax explain buffer-lifetime
ax explain blocking
```

Ví dụ:

```text
NetworkBuffer #42
 ├── owner: BufferPool #3
 ├── DMA: active
 ├── mutable: no
 ├── pending operation: Write #17
 └── reusable: after Completion #17
```

Đây chính là loại thông tin cực kỳ hữu ích cho AI coding agent.

---

# 206.99. Network correctness boundary

Mọi backend:

```text
TCP
UDP
QUIC
io_uring
IOCP
RDMA
kernel-bypass
```

đều phải map về semantic model:

```text
Ownership
Capability
Lifetime
Completion
Cancellation
Effect
```

Backend không được tự tạo một semantics riêng phá vỡ compiler verifier.

---

# 206.100. Network invariants — `ANET2`

### `ANET2-20`
Network protocols shall remain library/system abstractions above Core.

### `ANET2-21`
Endpoint identity shall remain distinct from socket resource identity.

### `ANET2-22`
Socket resources shall obey ordinary Axiom ownership and Drop semantics.

### `ANET2-23`
Drop shall not imply graceful protocol shutdown.

### `ANET2-24`
TCP shall be modeled as an ordered byte stream rather than an implicit message protocol.

### `ANET2-25`
Application framing shall remain explicit.

### `ANET2-26`
Half-close semantics shall be represented explicitly where supported.

### `ANET2-27`
TCP partial writes shall not be silently interpreted as complete writes.

### `ANET2-28`
UDP shall not imply delivery, ordering or uniqueness.

### `ANET2-29`
QUIC streams shall remain distinct logical streams within a connection.

### `ANET2-30`
Stream lifetime shall respect connection dependencies.

### `ANET2-31`
TLS shall remain a protocol/security layer rather than a Core primitive.

### `ANET2-32`
Private cryptographic material shall obey explicit ownership semantics.

### `ANET2-33`
Network serialization shall remain distinct from memory representation.

### `ANET2-34`
Unvalidated network bytes shall not become safe typed values.

### `ANET2-35`
Zero-copy views shall not outlive their backing storage.

### `ANET2-36`
Scatter/gather operations shall obey capability overlap rules.

### `ANET2-37`
Pending I/O shall retain required resource ownership until completion or valid cancellation.

### `ANET2-38`
I/O cancellation races shall have defined semantics.

### `ANET2-39`
Readiness and completion semantics shall remain distinct.

### `ANET2-40`
io_uring, IOCP, epoll and kqueue shall remain backend implementations.

### `ANET2-41`
Blocking and asynchronous network APIs shall remain semantically distinct.

### `ANET2-42`
Async APIs shall not hide unbounded blocking operations.

### `ANET2-43`
Network buffer pools shall provide explicit ownership transfer.

### `ANET2-44`
DMA buffers shall obey external-agent access contracts.

### `ANET2-45`
CPU mutable access shall not conflict with active device/DMA access.

### `ANET2-46`
RDMA memory registration shall remain valid for all dependent operations.

### `ANET2-47`
RDMA completion shall govern reuse of externally accessed buffers.

### `ANET2-48`
Kernel-bypass APIs shall remain explicit system/unsafe abstractions.

### `ANET2-49`
Network rate limiting shall remain distinct from backpressure and concurrency limits.

### `ANET2-50`
Retry shall respect idempotency and deadline semantics.

### `ANET2-51`
Connection pooling shall preserve connection/resource ownership.

### `ANET2-52`
Connection reuse shall remain protocol-specific.

### `ANET2-53`
Network effects shall be visible to the effect/tooling system.

### `ANET2-54`
Network capabilities shall remain separate from language memory capabilities.

### `ANET2-55`
Raw socket and packet APIs shall require explicit system/unsafe access.

### `ANET2-56`
Security-sensitive memory operations shall not be optimized away when their semantic contract requires execution.

### `ANET2-57`
Network backends shall lower to the same ownership/capability/completion semantics.

### `ANET2-58`
WASM and freestanding targets may omit networking capabilities without changing Core semantics.

### `ANET2-59`
Network abstractions shall not require garbage collection.

### `ANET2-60`
Network abstractions shall not require a monolithic runtime.

### `ANET2-61`
High-level network abstractions shall permit compiler elimination/inlining of abstraction overhead.

### `ANET2-62`
Zero-copy shall be an optimization and API capability, not a mandatory requirement.

### `ANET2-63`
Copying shall remain semantically distinct from zero-copy storage sharing.

### `ANET2-64`
Compiler-generated network code shall pass ordinary ownership, capability and concurrency verification.

### `ANET2-65`
Network resource lifetimes shall be visible to CompilerDB.

### `ANET2-66`
AI tooling shall be able to inspect network buffer ownership and pending I/O state.

### `ANET2-67`
Network protocol implementations shall support deterministic testing where practical.

### `ANET2-68`
Network fault injection shall be part of conformance/testing infrastructure.

### `ANET2-69`
Protocol parsing shall support zero-copy operation without weakening memory safety.

### `ANET2-70`
Network APIs shall not introduce programmer-written lifetime annotations.

### `ANET2-71`
Network APIs shall preserve the distinction between local ownership and remote/distributed ownership.

### `ANET2-72`
Network semantics shall compose with Async, Storage, Distributed Systems, Time and Security models.

---

# Kiến trúc networking cuối cùng

```text
                       APPLICATION
                            │
                ┌───────────┼───────────┐
                ▼           ▼           ▼
              HTTP         RPC       WebSocket
                │           │
                └──────┬────┘
                       ▼
                  Protocol
                       │
              ┌────────┼────────┐
              ▼        ▼        ▼
             TCP      QUIC      UDP
              │        │        │
              └────┬───┴───┬────┘
                   ▼       ▼
                 Socket   TLS
                   │
              Async I/O
                   │
       ┌───────────┼───────────┐
       ▼           ▼           ▼
    io_uring     IOCP       kqueue/epoll
       │
       ▼
    Kernel
       │
       ▼
      NIC
       │
       ▼
   DMA buffers
```

Ở tầng thấp hơn:

```text
Buffer
  │
  ├── CPU view
  ├── DMA view
  ├── Network view
  └── Pending I/O capability
```

Compiler có thể theo dõi quan hệ này mà **programmer không phải viết lifetime/borrow annotation**.

Đây là một trong những điểm mà mô hình Axiom hiện tại có lợi thế rõ ràng: `view/mut_view + ownership + async + capability verification` có thể xử lý cả HTTP thông thường lẫn RDMA mà không cần tạo hai hệ thống memory management khác nhau.

---

# BOOTSTRAP-207 — Compression, Serialization, Binary Formats, IPC & Data Interchange

**TRẠNG THÁI: NEXT**

Sau khi đã khóa Network, bước kế tiếp nên xử lý **data representation bên ngoài process** một cách có hệ thống:

```text
Axiom Value
    │
    ├── Memory Representation
    │

    │
```

```text
Deserialization
Schema
Schema evolution
```

# BOOTSTRAP-207 — Serialization, Compression, Binary Formats, IPC & Data Interchange

**TRẠNG THÁI: FROZEN / COMPLETED**

Mục tiêu của 207:

> **Axiom phải phân biệt rõ giá trị trong bộ nhớ, dữ liệu trên wire, dữ liệu persistent và dữ liệu IPC, nhưng vẫn cho phép compiler tối ưu xuống zero-copy khi representation thực sự tương thích.**

Đây là tầng rất quan trọng vì Axiom hiện đã có:

```text
Memory
Storage
Network
Distributed Systems
IPC
GPU
FFI
```

Nếu không tách representation đúng, ngôn ngữ rất dễ rơi vào một trong hai cực:

- an toàn nhưng copy quá nhiều;
- zero-copy nhưng phá vỡ memory safety.

---

# 207.1. Bốn loại representation

Axiom khóa:

```text
Semantic Value
      │
      ├── Memory Representation
      │
      ├── Wire Representation
      │
      ├── Persistent Representation
      │
      └── IPC Representation
```

Không mặc định chúng giống nhau.

---

# 207.2. Semantic value ≠ bytes

Ví dụ:

```axiom
struct User {
    id: u64
    name: String
}
```

Không được mặc định:

```text
User == raw bytes
```

vì:

- `String` có ownership;
- representation có thể chứa pointer/metadata;
- field layout có thể được compiler reorder;
- padding không có semantic meaning.

---

# 207.3. Memory representation

Đây là representation phục vụ execution:

```text
size
alignment
field offsets
niches
padding
ABI
```

được quyết định bởi compiler trừ khi có `repr` contract.

---

# 207.4. Wire representation

Wire format phải có contract độc lập:

```text
endianness
field encoding
length encoding
alignment
version
optional fields
unknown fields
```

---

# 207.5. Persistent representation

Storage format có thêm:

```text
version
schema
checksums
page boundaries
migration
durability
compatibility
```

Không mặc định giống network wire format.

---

# 207.6. IPC representation

IPC có thể dùng:

```text
serialization
shared memory
mapped file
OS message
handle transfer
```

Tùy platform.

---

# 207.7. Serialization trait

Library có thể cung cấp:

```axiom
trait Serialize<Format> {
    fn encode(self: view<Self>, out: mut_view<Encoder<Format>>) -> Result<(), Error>
}
```

Conceptual semantics quan trọng hơn syntax cuối cùng.

---

# 207.8. Deserialize

```axiom
trait Deserialize<Format> {
    fn decode(input: mut_view<Decoder<Format>>) -> Result<Self, Error>
}
```

`Deserialize` tạo **giá trị mới có ownership hợp lệ**.

---

# 207.9. Serialization không implicit

Không cho compiler tự động:

```text
struct → JSON
```

trong mọi context.

Phải có:

- compiler-known derive;
- trait implementation;
- comptime generation;
- explicit schema.

---

# 207.10. `@derive(Serialize)`

Đây là trường hợp phù hợp với hệ thống `@derive` đã khóa:

```axiom
@derive(Serialize, Deserialize)
struct User {
    id: u64
    name: String
}
```

Compiler/comptime sinh code typed.

Generated code quay lại pipeline bình thường:

```text
Generated HIR
 → typecheck
 → ownership
 → capability
 → verification
```

---

# 207.11. Không dùng textual macro

Serialization generation không cần:

```text
generate string source
```

mà nên tạo typed declarations/HIR.

---

# 207.12. Schema

Schema là metadata mô tả data contract:

```text
Schema
 ├── fields
 ├── types
 ├── optionality
 ├── encoding
 └── version
```

---

# 207.13. SchemaFingerprint

Schema có fingerprint riêng:

```text
SchemaFingerprint
```

không dùng:

```text
SemanticFingerprint
```

# 207.32. Zero-copy deserialization

```text
      │
      ▼
BorrowedMessage
```

```text
backing storage alive
```

hỗ trợ streaming.

```text
tag
tag + payload
```

# 207.85. Bitcast vs Deserialize


với:

# 207.87. Alignment


# 207.90. Data interchange pipeline

Kiến trúc hoàn chỉnh:

```text

          ▼            ▼            ▼

          │            │            │
          │       ┌────┴────┐       │
          │       ▼         ▼       │

                       ▼
```

# 207.91. Zero-copy decision tree

Compiler/library có thể chọn:

```text
Is representation compatible?
        │
       YES
        │
Is alignment valid?
        │
       YES
        │
Is backing storage alive?
        │
       YES
        │
Is access capability valid?
        │
       YES
        │
      ZERO-COPY
```

Nếu bất kỳ điều kiện nào không chứng minh được:

```text
       ↓
safe decode/copy
```

Ngay cả khi format không zero-copy, compiler vẫn có thể eliminate intermediate copies:

```text

 ↓
decode
 ↓
```

thay vì:

```text
network
 ↓
temporary bytes
 ↓
temporary struct
 ↓
final struct
```


nếu compiler generate static encoder.

# 207.96. Dynamic schemas

```text
Schema
```

là explicit library feature.

```text
 ↓

 ↓
Ownership
 ↓

 ↓

 ↓
```

### `ADATA-30`

# Kết quả kiến trúc 207

Axiom giờ có một separation rất sạch:

```text
                  SEMANTIC VALUE
                        │
          ┌─────────────┼──────────────┐
          │             │              │
        MEMORY         WIRE         STORAGE
          │             │              │
       ABI/layout    protocol        persistence
          │             │              │
          └─────────────┼──────────────┘
                        │
                     IPC
```

Và compiler có thể tối ưu:

```text
normal case
    ↓
safe copy

compatible case
    ↓
zero-copy view

provably constructible case
    ↓
in-place construction

optimization case
    ↓
copy/temporary/allocation elimination
```

**Programmer không phải viết lifetime annotation để đạt zero-copy.**

Đây chính xác là triết lý Axiom:

> **Programmer mô tả semantic intent; compiler chứng minh và tối ưu implementation.**

---
