# BOOTSTRAP-208 — Cryptography, Secure Memory, Constant-Time & Hardware Security

**TRẠNG THÁI: FROZEN / COMPLETED**

Mục tiêu của 208:

> **Axiom phải cho phép xây dựng cryptographic software hiệu năng cao mà compiler hiểu được các security contract quan trọng, thay vì coi crypto chỉ là một hàm `extern`.**

Điểm quan trọng: **constant-time không thể chỉ là lời hứa của programmer**. Compiler phải hiểu đây là một semantic/security contract để không tối ưu làm mất tính chất đó.

---

# 208.1. Phân tầng Cryptography

Kiến trúc:

```text
Application
    │
    ├── Authentication
    ├── Authorization
    ├── Secure Channel
    └── Protocol
            │
            ▼
     Cryptographic Library
            │
    ┌───────┼────────┐
    ▼       ▼        ▼
   AEAD    Hash      Signature
    │       │        │
    └───────┼────────┘
            ▼
       Crypto Backend
            │
      ┌─────┼─────┐
      ▼     ▼     ▼
    CPU    SIMD   Hardware
```

Core không chứa thuật toán cụ thể.

---

# 208.2. Cryptographic primitive là typed API

Không dùng API kiểu:

```text
encrypt(bytes, bytes)
```

một cách mơ hồ.

Nên có các type:

```text
Key
Nonce
Ciphertext
Plaintext
Tag
Signature
PublicKey
PrivateKey
Digest
```

để compiler và programmer không dễ truyền nhầm dữ liệu.

---

# 208.3. Key không phải Bytes

Ví dụ:

```text
Key<AES256>
```

khác:

```text
Bytes
```

Một key có semantic contract riêng:

```text
secret
algorithm
length
lifetime
usage
```

---

# 208.4. Key typing

Conceptual:

```axiom
key: Key<AES256>
nonce: Nonce<AESGCM>
```

Không cho phép implicit:

```text
Key<AES256> → Key<ChaCha20>
```

---

# 208.5. Secret data

Compiler có thể biết một value là:

```text
Secret<T>
```

và áp dụng security metadata:

```text
no-debug
no-logging
no-implicit-copy
secure-drop
```

---

# 208.6. Secret ≠ immutable

Secret có thể mutable nếu thuật toán cần:

```text
SecretBuffer
```

nhưng capability vẫn kiểm soát mutation.

---

# 208.7. Secret copying

Không cấm mọi copy tuyệt đối, nhưng copy secret phải là semantic operation có thể quan sát qua security tooling.

Mục tiêu:

```text
không vô tình copy key
```

---

# 208.8. Secret lifetime

Key có thể được:

```text
create
use
rotate
destroy
```

và compiler/library đảm bảo ownership.

---

# 208.9. Zeroization

Một secret buffer có thể có:

```text
SecureDrop
```

để zero memory trước khi resource/storage được release.

Compiler không được loại bỏ operation này nếu semantic contract yêu cầu.

---

# 208.10. Dead-store elimination exception

Thông thường:

```text
x = 0
```

ngay trước deallocation có thể bị optimizer loại.

Nhưng với:

```text
SecureZero(x)
```

đây là observable security operation và **không được loại bỏ**.

---

# 208.11. Constant-time

Axiom định nghĩa security property:

> **Execution behavior không được phụ thuộc vào secret data theo các kênh được contract bảo vệ.**

Không giới hạn đơn giản ở "số instruction luôn giống nhau".

---

# 208.12. Constant-time scope

Constant-time có thể áp dụng cho:

```text
@constant_time
fn verify(...)
```

hoặc block:

```text
@constant_time {
    ...
}
```

---

# 208.13. Secret-dependent branch

Trong constant-time region:

```axiom
if secret_bit {
    ...
}
```

phải bị compiler kiểm tra.

Nếu branch ảnh hưởng observable timing:

```text
compile error
```

hoặc yêu cầu explicit unsafe/security escape.

---

# 208.14. Secret-dependent memory access

Nguy hiểm:

```text
table[secret]
```

Compiler phải phát hiện trong constant-time code nếu index có thể leak qua cache/memory behavior.

---

# 208.15. Constant-time ≠ no branch

Branch trên public data vẫn hợp lệ:

```text
if packet_length > 0 {
    ...
}
```

Vấn đề là dependency:

```text
public
```

hay:

```text
secret
```

---

# 208.16. Data classification

Compiler security analysis có thể phân biệt:

```text
PUBLIC
SECRET
SENSITIVE
UNKNOWN
```

`UNKNOWN` không được tự động coi là PUBLIC trong constant-time proof.

---

# 208.17. Secret flow

Ví dụ:

```text
key
 ↓
hash
 ↓
digest
```

ta cần security taint:

```text
SECRET → derived SECRET
```

hoặc primitive-specific declassification.

---

# 208.18. Public declassification

Hash của secret không mặc định trở thành public.

Ví dụ password hash:

```text
hash(password)
```

vẫn có thể là sensitive.

Do đó:

```text
Secret
 ↓
Hash
 ↓
SensitiveDigest
```

---

# 208.19. Declassification

Nếu application muốn công khai một derived value:

```text
declassify(x)
```

phải là explicit security operation.

Không implicit.

---

# 208.20. Constant-time comparison

Không dùng:

```text
a == b
```

cho cryptographic secret nếu implementation có early exit.

Library cung cấp:

```text
constant_time_equal(a, b)
```

Compiler có thể recognize primitive này.

---

# 208.21. Compiler recognition

Compiler có thể có intrinsic:

```text
ct_eq
ct_select
ct_compare
ct_swap
```

nhưng chúng vẫn có semantic definitions.

---

# 208.22. Constant-time select

Ví dụ conceptual:

```text
result = ct_select(condition, a, b)
```

không branch theo secret.

---

# 208.23. Constant-time arithmetic

Compiler phải tránh biến đổi:

```text
constant-time arithmetic
```

thành implementation có secret-dependent control flow nếu contract cấm.

---

# 208.24. Division

Một vấn đề quan trọng:

```text
secret / public
```

có thể tạo instruction latency khác nhau tùy architecture.

Constant-time verifier không được chỉ kiểm tra source-level branch.

Backend security metadata phải tồn tại.

---

# 208.25. Variable-latency instructions

Backend có thể đánh dấu instruction:

```text
ConstantLatency
VariableLatency
UnknownLatency
```

Trong strict constant-time profile:

```text
VariableLatency
UnknownLatency
```

không được dùng trên secret-dependent operands nếu contract không cho phép.

---

# 208.26. CPU instruction selection

Compiler có thể chọn:

```text
AES-NI
AVX2
AVX-512
SHA extensions
NEON
```

nhưng phải giữ security contract.

---

# 208.27. Hardware acceleration

Crypto backend:

```text
AES-GCM
ChaCha20
SHA-256
SHA-3
```

có thể sử dụng hardware instructions.

Không cần programmer viết assembly.

---

# 208.28. SIMD crypto

Compiler có thể vectorize independent operations.

Nhưng vectorization phải giữ:

```text
constant-time
memory access
observable behavior
```

---

# 208.29. Constant-time vectorization

Nếu source có:

```text
ct loop
```

compiler có thể vectorize nếu proof vẫn hợp lệ.

Nếu không:

```text
do not transform
```

---

# 208.30. Fast-math interaction

Crypto code không được tự động áp dụng fast-math.

Đặc biệt:

```text
floating-point
```

không phải lựa chọn mặc định cho cryptographic arithmetic.

---

# 208.31. Cryptographic randomness

Randomness có nhiều cấp:

```text
PseudoRandom
SecureRandom
HardwareRandom
DeterministicRandom
```

không được gộp thành `Random`.

---

# 208.32. CSPRNG

API:

```text
SecureRandom
```

phải có explicit security source.

Ví dụ:

```text
OS entropy
hardware RNG
approved DRBG
```

---

# 208.33. Randomness failure

Nếu hệ thống không lấy được entropy:

```text
Result<RandomBytes, RandomError>
```

Không silently fallback sang insecure PRNG.

---

# 208.34. Deterministic cryptographic tests

Test environment có thể inject:

```text
DeterministicRandom
```

nhưng production API không được âm thầm dùng implementation này.

---

# 208.35. Nonce

Nonce là type riêng:

```text
Nonce<Algorithm>
```

không chỉ là `[u8; 12]`.

---

# 208.36. Nonce uniqueness

Một số algorithm yêu cầu:

```text
unique nonce per key
```

Đây là semantic protocol invariant, không chỉ type-level length check.

---

# 208.37. AEAD

High-level API:

```text
seal(key, nonce, plaintext, associated_data)
open(key, nonce, ciphertext, associated_data)
```

---

# 208.38. Authentication failure

AEAD failure:

```text
AuthenticationFailed
```

là recoverable Result.

Không trả plaintext một phần.

---

# 208.39. Partial plaintext

Nếu authentication chưa thành công:

```text
plaintext capability
```

không được expose cho caller.

---

# 208.40. Hash

Hash API:

```text
Hash<Algorithm>
```

và incremental:

```text
Hasher
```

---

# 208.41. Hash state ownership

Hasher state có ownership bình thường:

```text
Hasher
 ↓ move
finalize()
```

Finalize có thể consume state.

---

# 208.42. MAC

MAC:

```text
Mac<KeyedAlgorithm>
```

khác Hash.

---

# 208.43. Signature

Signature:

```text
Signature<Algorithm>
```

khác MAC vì verification không yêu cầu secret key phía verifier.

---

# 208.44. Public/private key distinction

Compiler type system không cho:

```text
PrivateKey → PublicKey
```

trừ explicit derivation:

```text
derive_public_key()
```

---

# 208.45. Key exchange

Ví dụ:

```text
PrivateKey
    ↓
KeyExchange
    ↓
SharedSecret
```

`SharedSecret` không tự động trở thành application key.

---

# 208.46. KDF

Key derivation:

```text
KDF
 ↓
DerivedKey<Context>
```

Context/domain separation phải explicit.

---

# 208.47. Domain separation

Cryptographic APIs nên hỗ trợ:

```text
context
purpose
label
```

để tránh reuse cùng secret material cho các protocol khác nhau.

---

# 208.48. Key usage restrictions

Có thể metadata:

```text
Key<EncryptOnly>
Key<SignOnly>
Key<KeyExchange>
```

để hạn chế misuse.

---

# 208.49. Key rotation

Key lifecycle:

```text
Active
 ↓
Rotating
 ↓
Deprecated
 ↓
Revoked
```

là library/security state, không phải Core type state bắt buộc.

---

# 208.50. Certificate

Certificate:

```text
Certificate
PublicKey
Signature
Validity
Extensions
```

---

# 208.51. Trust store

Trust store là external policy:

```text
TrustStore
```

không hard-code vào compiler.

---

# 208.52. Certificate verification

Verification trả structured result/error:

```text
Expired
NotYetValid
UnknownIssuer
InvalidSignature
HostnameMismatch
Revoked
UnsupportedAlgorithm
```

---

# 208.53. Secure channel

Network stack:

```text
TcpStream
    ↓
TlsStream
    ↓
HttpConnection
```

đã phù hợp với architecture 206.

---

# 208.54. Authentication

Authentication và encryption là hai vấn đề khác nhau.

Axiom không gộp:

```text
encrypted
```

với:

```text
authenticated
```

---

# 208.55. Authorization

Authorization nằm trên authentication:

```text
Identity
 ↓
Authentication
 ↓
Authorization
 ↓
Action
```

---

# 208.56. Capability tokens

Axiom có thể xây capability token:

```text
CapabilityToken<Resource>
```

nhưng đây là library/security abstraction.

Không phải Core `capability` memory type.

Hai khái niệm phải giữ riêng:

```text
Memory Capability
        ≠
Security Authority Capability
```

---

# 208.57. Security authority

Security capability có thể đại diện:

```text
NetworkAccess
FileAccess
DatabaseAccess
DeviceAccess
```

nhưng không thay đổi memory verifier.

---

# 208.58. Memory capability vs authority

Đây là distinction quan trọng:

```text
view<T>
```

nói:

> được đọc vùng memory này.

Trong khi:

```text
NetworkCapability
```

nói:

> được thực hiện network operation này.

---

# 208.59. Secure memory storage

Có thể có:

```text
SecureBuffer<T>
```

với:

- locked pages nếu OS hỗ trợ;
- zero-on-drop;
- no swap policy nếu hỗ trợ;
- restricted debugging policy.

---

# 208.60. Không guarantee tuyệt đối

Compiler không được tuyên bố:

```text
SecureBuffer
```

đảm bảo secret không bao giờ xuất hiện ở swap/dump/register/cache trên mọi hardware.

Chỉ guarantee những semantics mà target/platform thực sự hỗ trợ.

---

# 208.61. Sensitive debug policy

Compiler/debugger nên biết:

```text
Secret
```

không nên mặc định hiển thị trong:

```text
debugger
crash dump
AI context
logs
```

---

# 208.62. AI security boundary

Đây đặc biệt quan trọng với Axiom.

CompilerDB/AI tooling phải tránh đưa:

```text
private keys
passwords
secret buffers
```

vào AI context mặc định.

AI có thể nhận:

```text
type
ownership
security classification
proof
```

thay vì raw secret value.

---

# 208.63. Compiler diagnostics

Không được diagnostic kiểu:

```text
expected key:
"actual secret value..."
```

Compiler phải redact sensitive values.

---

# 208.64. Secure logging

`Secret<T>` không tự động implement debug formatting:

```text
Debug(Secret)
```

nên cho:

```text
<redacted>
```

---

# 208.65. Side-channel model

Axiom security model nhận diện các kênh:

```text
Timing
Cache
Branch prediction
Memory access
Power
EM
Speculation
Resource contention
```

Compiler chỉ có thể kiểm soát một phần.

---

# 208.66. Constant-time scope

`@constant_time` không có nghĩa:

> chống mọi side channel.

Nó là một contract giới hạn phạm vi:

> compiler không được tạo các secret-dependent behaviors thuộc các lớp mà target/profile có thể kiểm chứng.

---

# 208.67. Speculation

Compiler/security backend có thể cung cấp primitive:

```text
speculation_barrier()
```

ở system layer.

---

# 208.68. Secret-dependent indexing

Trong strict mode:

```text
table[secret]
```

có thể bị reject.

Có thể thay bằng:

```text
constant_time_lookup(table, secret)
```

---

# 208.69. Constant-time verification

Compiler pipeline:

```text
Typed MIR
   ↓
Security Taint Analysis
   ↓
Constant-Time Analysis
   ↓
Verified MIR
   ↓
Optimization
   ↓
Backend Security Validation
```

---

# 208.70. Optimization legality

Optimization pass phải khai báo:

```text
preserves_constant_time = true
```

nếu áp dụng lên constant-time region.

Nếu không chứng minh được:

```text
skip transformation
```

---

# 208.71. Security-aware alias analysis

Compiler có thể sử dụng:

```text
SecretRegion
PublicRegion
```

để tránh những optimization tạo side-channel.

---

# 208.72. Security-aware vectorization

Vectorization được phép nếu:

```text
semantic correctness
+
constant-time contract
```

đều được bảo toàn.

---

# 208.73. FFI crypto

Foreign crypto library phải khai báo:

```text
FfiContract
```

bao gồm:

```text
constant-time
secret handling
memory ownership
thread safety
```

---

# 208.74. Assembly crypto

Inline assembly/system intrinsic có thể khai báo:

```text
@constant_time
@secret_safe
```

nhưng compiler không được tin annotation vô điều kiện nếu có machine-verifiable contract.

Unsafe vẫn là trust boundary.

---

# 208.75. Hardware crypto

Hardware acceleration có contract:

```text
CryptoBackend
```

và có thể fallback:

```text
software backend
```

nhưng security profile phải biết backend nào đang được dùng.

---

# 208.76. CPU feature dispatch

Có thể:

```text
AES-NI
AVX2
AVX-512
NEON
SHA extensions
```

với multiversioning.

Compiler đảm bảo mỗi variant có cùng security semantics.

---

# 208.77. Hardware security

Platform layer có thể expose:

```text
TPM
Secure Enclave
HSM
KeyStore
Hardware RNG
```

---

# 208.78. TPM

TPM resource:

```text
TpmDevice
TpmKey
```

không expose private key bytes nếu key nằm hardware.

---

# 208.79. Hardware-backed key

Một key có thể có:

```text
HardwareKey
```

không thể `Copy` ra `Bytes`.

---

# 208.80. HSM

HSM API tương tự:

```text
Remote/HardwareKeyHandle
```

operations chạy bên ngoài process memory.

---

# 208.81. Secure enclave

Secure enclave execution là execution/storage domain riêng ở platform layer.

Không giả định CPU memory capability có thể truy cập trực tiếp enclave memory.

---

# 208.82. Key handles

Hardware key identity:

```text
KeyHandle
```

khác:

```text
PrivateKeyBytes
```

---

# 208.83. Secure deletion

Hardware-backed key có thể:

```text
destroy()
```

nhưng semantics phụ thuộc device.

Không tuyên bố physical destruction nếu hardware chỉ revoke key.

---

# 208.84. Password handling

Password phải được coi là:

```text
Secret<Text>
```

không plain `String` trong security API.

---

# 208.85. Password hashing

Password storage nên dùng dedicated password KDF:

```text
Argon2
scrypt
bcrypt
```

ở library layer.

Không dùng raw SHA-256 như password hashing API.

---

# 208.86. Password verification

Verification nên dùng constant-time comparison khi thích hợp.

---

# 208.87. Cryptographic API misuse resistance

High-level API nên làm impossible hoặc khó:

```text
wrong key type
wrong nonce size
wrong algorithm
plaintext after auth failure
secret accidental logging
```

---

# 208.88. Algorithm agility

Protocol có thể support nhiều algorithms nhưng selection phải explicit và policy-controlled.

Không tự động downgrade sang insecure algorithm.

---

# 208.89. Deprecated algorithms

Library metadata có thể đánh dấu:

```text
Secure
Legacy
Deprecated
Forbidden
```

Tooling cảnh báo hoặc reject theo security profile.

---

# 208.90. Cryptographic protocol versioning

Security protocol version phải tham gia:

```text
SchemaFingerprint
ProtocolFingerprint
```

hoặc security-specific fingerprint khi cần.

---

# 208.91. Security profile

Build profile có thể:

```text
security-strict
security-hardened
constant-time
embedded
```

nhưng không thay đổi Core semantics.

---

# 208.92. Hardened build

Hardened profile có thể bật:

```text
stack protection
CFI
ASLR-compatible output
RELRO
W^X
shadow stack
control-flow protection
```

tùy target.

---

# 208.93. Security metadata

Compiler có thể xuất:

```text
.axsec
```

hoặc tích hợp vào `.axmeta`.

Metadata có thể mô tả:

```text
secret flows
constant-time regions
FFI security contracts
required hardware features
security profile
```

---

# 208.94. Security metadata không phải runtime

Không được biến security metadata thành mandatory runtime dependency.

---

# 208.95. Security verification boundary

Final compiler pipeline:

```text
Source
 ↓
Typed HIR
 ↓
MIR
 ↓
Ownership
 ↓
Capability
 ↓
Concurrency
 ↓
Security/Taint
 ↓
Constant-Time
 ↓
Verified MIR
 ↓
Optimization
 ↓
Backend Security Validation
 ↓
Machine Code
```

---

# 208.96. Crypto testing

Testing phải bao gồm:

```text
known-answer tests
test vectors
property tests
fuzzing
differential tests
negative tests
constant-time checks
fault injection
```

---

# 208.97. Constant-time testing

Timing tests chỉ là evidence.

Không được coi:

```text
"benchmark thấy timing giống nhau"
```

là proof.

Proof phải dựa vào compiler/security model.

---

# 208.98. Formal security properties

Những property có thể formalize:

```text
NoSecretBranch
NoSecretIndex
NoSecretDependentLoop
NoSecretLeakToIO
NoSecretDebug
NoSecretImplicitCopy
```

tùy security profile.

---

# 208.99. Crypto compiler contract

Mỗi crypto/security-sensitive optimization phải có:

```text
Preconditions
Transformation
PreservedSecurityProperties
Validation
```

Nếu không chứng minh:

```text
NO TRANSFORM
```

---

# 208.100. Cryptography & security invariants — `ASEC2`

### `ASEC2-20`
Cryptographic primitives shall remain library/system abstractions above Core.

### `ASEC2-21`
Cryptographic keys shall use typed semantic representations.

### `ASEC2-22`
Keys shall not implicitly convert to arbitrary byte buffers.

### `ASEC2-23`
Secret values shall carry security classification where required.

### `ASEC2-24`
Secret data shall not be implicitly exposed through debugging or diagnostics.

### `ASEC2-25`
Required secure-zeroization operations shall be semantically observable to the optimizer.

### `ASEC2-26`
Constant-time shall be an explicit compiler-visible security contract.

### `ASEC2-27`
Secret-dependent control flow shall be rejected or explicitly authorized in strict constant-time regions.

### `ASEC2-28`
Secret-dependent memory access shall be rejected or explicitly authorized according to the active security profile.

### `ASEC2-29`
Unknown security classification shall not silently become public inside strict constant-time analysis.

### `ASEC2-30`
Security taint shall propagate through derived cryptographic values according to primitive contracts.

### `ASEC2-31`
Declassification shall be explicit.

### `ASEC2-32`
Constant-time comparison shall use a dedicated semantic primitive.

### `ASEC2-33`
Variable-latency machine operations shall be tracked by the security-aware backend.

### `ASEC2-34`
Optimization shall not violate constant-time contracts.

### `ASEC2-35`
Vectorization shall preserve constant-time guarantees.

### `ASEC2-36`
CPU feature specialization shall preserve cryptographic semantics and security contracts.

### `ASEC2-37`
Hardware crypto acceleration shall remain semantically equivalent to the approved software implementation.

### `ASEC2-38`
CSPRNG failure shall not silently fall back to insecure randomness.

### `ASEC2-39`
Nonce types shall remain algorithm-specific where nonce uniqueness/format is security-critical.

### `ASEC2-40`
AEAD authentication failure shall not expose unauthenticated plaintext.

### `ASEC2-41`
Hash, MAC, signature and encryption semantics shall remain distinct.

### `ASEC2-42`
Private and public key types shall remain distinct.

### `ASEC2-43`
Key derivation shall support explicit domain separation.

### `ASEC2-44`
Cryptographic keys shall support explicit lifecycle and rotation semantics.

### `ASEC2-45`
Hardware-backed keys shall not implicitly become extractable private-key bytes.

### `ASEC2-46`
TPM/HSM/secure-enclave resources shall obey ordinary Axiom resource ownership.

### `ASEC2-47`
Security authority capabilities shall remain distinct from memory capabilities.

### `ASEC2-48`
Authentication shall remain distinct from authorization.

### `ASEC2-49`
Encryption shall not imply authentication.

### `ASEC2-50`
Security profiles shall not silently weaken cryptographic guarantees.

### `ASEC2-51`
Deprecated or forbidden cryptographic algorithms shall be enforceable by tooling/profile policy.

### `ASEC2-52`
Password hashing shall use dedicated password-KDF APIs rather than generic hashes.

### `ASEC2-53`
Security-sensitive FFI shall declare relevant security contracts.

### `ASEC2-54`
Unsafe assembly shall not automatically gain verified constant-time status merely through an annotation.

### `ASEC2-55`
Constant-time testing shall not be treated as a substitute for compiler-level security verification.

### `ASEC2-56`
Security metadata shall remain optional tooling/build metadata rather than mandatory runtime state.

### `ASEC2-57`
Compiler diagnostics shall redact secret values.

### `ASEC2-58`
AI tooling shall not expose secret values merely to explain compiler behavior.

### `ASEC2-59`
Security properties shall be visible through CompilerDB.

### `ASEC2-60`
Security-sensitive generated code shall pass ordinary compiler verification.

### `ASEC2-61`
Crypto code shall remain compatible with zero-cost abstraction principles.

### `ASEC2-62`
Crypto APIs shall not require garbage collection.

### `ASEC2-63`
Crypto APIs shall not require a monolithic runtime.

### `ASEC2-64`
Security contracts shall compose with Ownership, Capability, Concurrency, Async, FFI and GPU models.

### `ASEC2-65`
Security verification shall occur before optimization.

### `ASEC2-66`
Security-aware backend validation shall occur after machine lowering.

### `ASEC2-67`
An optimization lacking a proof of security-contract preservation shall not be applied to protected code.

### `ASEC2-68`
Constant-time guarantees shall be target/profile-specific where hardware behavior differs.

### `ASEC2-69`
Axiom shall distinguish memory safety from cryptographic side-channel security.

### `ASEC2-70`
Axiom shall not claim protection against physical side channels beyond the guarantees established by the target and security profile.

### `ASEC2-71`
Cryptographic protocol compatibility shall remain distinct from Axiom ABI compatibility.

### `ASEC2-72`
Security failures shall be represented through explicit Result/error semantics where recovery is possible.

### `ASEC2-73`
Cryptographic verification shall remain deterministic under fixed inputs and approved randomness sources.

### `ASEC2-74`
Security regression tests shall become permanent compiler/library conformance tests.

### `ASEC2-75`
AI-generated cryptographic code shall receive exactly the same security verification as human-written code.

---

# Kiến trúc security cuối cùng

Axiom hiện có một pipeline khá mạnh:

```text
                 SOURCE
                    │
                    ▼
               Typed HIR
                    │
                    ▼
                  MIR
                    │
        ┌───────────┼────────────┐
        ▼           ▼            ▼
   Ownership    Capability   Concurrency
        │           │            │
        └───────────┼────────────┘
                    ▼
              Security/Taint
                    │
                    ▼
             Constant-Time
                    │
                    ▼
             VERIFIED MIR
                    │
                    ▼
              Optimization
                    │
                    ▼
          Security-aware Backend
                    │
                    ▼
               MACHINE CODE
```

Điểm quan trọng nhất là **security không trở thành một hệ thống compiler riêng biệt**. Nó sử dụng chính nền móng Axiom đã xây:

```text
Ownership
Capability
Effect
Concurrency
FFI
CompilerDB
Verified MIR
```

và bổ sung:

```text
Security Classification
Taint
Constant-Time Contract
Security-aware Optimization
```

Điều này giữ đúng triết lý:

> **Compiler phức tạp hơn, nhưng ngôn ngữ không bắt programmer phải phức tạp hơn.**

---

# BOOTSTRAP-209 — AI/ML, Tensor, Automatic Differentiation & Heterogeneous Computing

**TRẠNG THÁI: NEXT**

Đây là bước đặc biệt quan trọng đối với mục tiêu ban đầu của Axiom: **AI support trên CPU + GPU nhưng vẫn giữ hiệu năng native**.

209 sẽ hợp nhất:

```text
Tensor
Shape
Stride
Layout
DType
SIMD
GPU
CPU
Autodiff
Graph
Kernel
Fusion
Memory planning
Training
Inference
Quantization
Sparse tensor
Distributed training
Collective communication
CUDA
ROCm
Metal
DirectML
CPU backend
```

và đặc biệt giải quyết vấn đề:

> **Làm thế nào để Axiom có khả năng AI/Tensor gần với PyTorch nhưng không biến ngôn ngữ thành một framework AI, không bắt buộc runtime AI, và vẫn cho phép compiler tối ưu tensor operation xuống CPU SIMD/GPU kernel/native code?**

parts:
# BOOTSTRAP-209 — AI/ML, Tensor, Automatic Differentiation & Heterogeneous Computing

**TRẠNG THÁI: FROZEN / COMPLETED**

Mục tiêu của 209 là để Axiom có thể xây dựng được:

- AI inference
- training
- tensor framework
- automatic differentiation
- custom kernels
- CPU SIMD/GPU acceleration
- quantization
- sparse computation
- distributed training

mà **không biến AI thành thành phần bắt buộc của Core** và không biến Axiom thành một bản sao của PyTorch.

Nguyên tắc trung tâm:

> **Tensor là abstraction của library; Shape/Layout/DType là semantic metadata; Kernel là computation; compiler/backend chịu trách nhiệm tối ưu và chọn CPU/GPU execution.**

---

# 209.1. Không đưa Tensor vào Core

Core chỉ cần những primitive đã có:

```text
Ownership
Capability
Generic
Comptime
SIMD
GPU
Async
Concurrency
Execution Domain
Storage Domain
```

Tensor nằm ở:

```text
Axiom Core
    │
    ├── SIMD
    ├── GPU
    ├── Comptime
    └── Generic
          │
          ▼
      Tensor Library
          │
     ┌────┼────┐
     ▼    ▼    ▼
    CPU  GPU  Accelerator
```

Điều này giữ được chương trình C-like cực nhỏ:

```axiom
fn main() {
    println("hello")
}
```

không kéo theo AI runtime.

---

# 209.2. Tensor không đồng nghĩa với Matrix

Cần phân biệt:

```text
Scalar
Vector
Matrix
Tensor
```

Tensor là N-dimensional array.

Ví dụ:

```text
Tensor<f32, [224,224,3]>
```

---

# 209.3. Shape là semantic metadata

Shape không nên chỉ là runtime `Vec<usize>`.

Compiler cần hiểu:

```text
[Batch, Height, Width, Channels]
```

nếu shape được biết tại compile time.

---

# 209.4. Static shape

Cho phép:

```axiom
Tensor<f32, [3, 224, 224]>
```

Compiler biết:

```text
rank = 3
shape = [3,224,224]
```

và có thể loại bỏ nhiều runtime check.

---

# 209.5. Dynamic shape

Vẫn phải hỗ trợ:

```axiom
Tensor<f32, DynShape>
```

cho model thực tế.

Ví dụ:

```text
batch = dynamic
sequence_length = dynamic
```

---

# 209.6. Shape không nên là type quá nặng

Không biến mọi phép toán tensor thành hệ thống dependent type khổng lồ.

Ví dụ:

```text
A : [M,K]
B : [K,N]
```

có thể được compiler kiểm tra nếu M/K/N known.

Nếu dynamic:

```text
runtime shape check
```

chứ không làm type system trở nên không sử dụng được.

---

# 209.7. Shape constraints

Tensor operation có thể khai báo:

```text
MatMul:
[A,B] × [B,C] → [A,C]
```

Compiler có thể kiểm tra constraint.

---

# 209.8. Layout

Shape chưa đủ.

Tensor cần:

```text
Shape
Stride
Offset
Layout
```

Ví dụ:

```text
NCHW
NHWC
CHWN
```

không nên là các Tensor type hoàn toàn khác nhau.

---

# 209.9. Stride

Một Tensor view có thể:

```text
shape = [3,224,224]
stride = [50176,224,1]
```

hoặc layout khác.

Stride là semantic metadata cần thiết cho zero-copy view.

---

# 209.10. Contiguous

Compiler/library có thể phân biệt:

```text
Contiguous
Strided
Broadcasted
Permuted
Sparse
Opaque
```

để chọn kernel.

---

# 209.11. TensorView

Không cần copy khi slicing:

```axiom
view<Tensor>
```

hoặc semantic equivalent:

```text
TensorView<T>
```

là non-owning.

Nó tuân theo capability model đã frozen.

---

# 209.12. Mutable tensor view

```text
TensorMutView<T>
```

tương ứng với:

```text
mut_view<T>
```

và phải tuân thủ exclusive mutation.

---

# 209.13. Tensor relocation

Nếu Tensor sở hữu storage:

```text
Tensor<T>
```

thì storage có thể relocate.

Một view đang sống sẽ ngăn relocation nếu relocation làm mất provenance.

---

# 209.14. Tensor storage

Tensor có thể nằm ở:

```text
CPU
GPU
Unified
PinnedHost
Mapped
External
```

nhưng storage domain phải explicit.

---

# 209.15. Device Tensor

Ví dụ:

```text
DeviceTensor<f32>
```

không được implicit đọc như CPU memory.

Phải có operation tương ứng:

```text
copy_to_host()
copy_to_device()
```

hoặc backend-specific transfer.

---

# 209.16. Zero-copy

Compiler có thể loại bỏ transfer nếu:

```text
same storage domain
compatible layout
compatible lifetime
compatible capability
```

Nhưng zero-copy là **optimization/proven property**, không phải assumption.

---

# 209.17. DType

Không chỉ:

```text
f32
f64
```

mà tensor library cần:

```text
f16
bf16
i8
u8
i4
u4
fp8
```

tùy target.

---

# 209.18. DType ≠ Axiom primitive type

Ví dụ:

```text
Tensor<fp8>
```

có thể là storage format.

Không nhất thiết Core phải có:

```text
fp8
```

như một scalar language type ngay từ đầu.

---

# 209.19. Quantized Tensor

Semantic metadata:

```text
Quantization
    dtype
    scale
    zero_point
    axis
```

để compiler/kernel biết cách diễn giải.

---

# 209.20. Tensor ownership

Tensor là ordinary owning value:

```text
Tensor<T>
```

có thể Move.

Không implicit shared mutable state.

---

# 209.21. Tensor Copy

Tensor lớn không được implicit Copy.

```text
Tensor<T>
```

thông thường:

```text
!Copy
```

Copy logic phải explicit:

```text
clone()
```

hoặc:

```text
copy_to(...)
```

---

# 209.22. Tensor expression

API có thể viết:

```axiom
C = A * B + D
```

nhưng compiler/library nên có khả năng biểu diễn expression graph:

```text
Mul(A,B)
   ↓
Add(_,D)
```

---

# 209.23. Expression templates không phải bắt buộc

Axiom không cần ép programmer dùng expression-template syntax.

Compiler có thể tạo intermediate representation trực tiếp.

---

# 209.24. Tensor IR

Compiler có thể có:

```text
TensorIR
```

sau semantic MIR:

```text
MIR
 ↓
Tensor Analysis
 ↓
TensorIR
 ↓
Kernel IR
 ↓
CPU/GPU backend
```

TensorIR không thay thế MIR.

---

# 209.25. Tensor operation

Các primitive:

```text
Add
Sub
Mul
Div
MatMul
Conv
Reduce
Transpose
Reshape
Broadcast
Gather
Scatter
Softmax
Norm
```

được biểu diễn ở library/compiler interface.

---

# 209.26. Broadcasting

Broadcasting phải có deterministic rules.

Ví dụ:

```text
[32,128]
+
[128]
=
[32,128]
```

Shape inference có thể kiểm tra compile-time nếu đủ thông tin.

---

# 209.27. Broadcast không copy

Broadcast view có thể biểu diễn stride bằng zero hoặc semantic equivalent.

Compiler không được biến broadcasting thành allocation/copy nếu không cần.

---

# 209.28. Reshape

Reshape chỉ zero-copy nếu layout cho phép.

Nếu không:

```text
reshape → copy
```

hoặc yêu cầu contiguous storage.

---

# 209.29. Transpose

Transpose thường chỉ tạo view:

```text
shape'
stride'
```

Không cần copy.

---

# 209.30. Materialization

Khi operation yêu cầu contiguous memory:

```text
materialize()
```

có thể tạo storage mới.

Đây phải là explicit semantic possibility để programmer/tooling biết.

---

# 209.31. Lazy vs eager

Tensor library có thể hỗ trợ cả:

```text
Eager Tensor
Lazy Graph
```

nhưng semantic result phải tương đương trong profile tương ứng.

---

# 209.32. Graph

Graph biểu diễn:

```text
Input
 ↓
Conv
 ↓
Relu
 ↓
MatMul
 ↓
Output
```

Graph là library/compiler abstraction.

---

# 209.33. Graph optimization

Compiler/framework có thể:

```text
constant folding
operator fusion
dead node elimination
layout propagation
memory reuse
kernel selection
```

---

# 209.34. Kernel fusion

Ví dụ:

```text
A * B
 ↓
Add(C)
 ↓
Relu
```

có thể trở thành một kernel.

Điều này đặc biệt quan trọng cho GPU.

---

# 209.35. Fusion không thay đổi semantics

Fusion chỉ được thực hiện nếu:

```text
observable behavior
floating-point profile
aliasing
effects
exceptions/errors
```

được bảo toàn.

---

# 209.36. Floating-point semantics

AI workloads thường cần fast math.

Axiom giữ nguyên nguyên tắc:

```text
Strict FP
```

là mặc định.

Có thể explicit:

```text
@fast_math
```

hoặc profile tương đương.

---

# 209.37. Fast-math

Fast-math có thể cho phép:

```text
reassociation
approximate reciprocal
approximate exp
FMA transformations
reduced NaN guarantees
```

nhưng đây là semantic profile rõ ràng.

---

# 209.38. Deterministic AI

Cần phân biệt:

```text
Semantic determinism
Numerical determinism
Hardware determinism
Distributed determinism
```

GPU parallel reduction có thể không bitwise deterministic.

Không được tuyên bố deterministic tuyệt đối chỉ vì cùng input.

---

# 209.39. Reduction

Ví dụ:

```text
sum(x)
```

có thể có nhiều execution order.

Strict mode:

```text
preserve defined order
```

Relaxed parallel mode:

```text
allow reassociation
```

---

# 209.40. Automatic Differentiation

Axiom hỗ trợ:

```text
AD
```

ở library/compiler layer.

Không cần syntax riêng bắt buộc.

---

# 209.41. Forward-mode AD

Concept:

```text
dual(x, dx)
```

Compiler/library có thể transform:

```text
f(x)
```

thành:

```text
(f(x), df/dx)
```

---

# 209.42. Reverse-mode AD

Graph:

```text
forward graph
      ↓
tape / graph
      ↓
backward graph
```

phù hợp neural-network training.

---

# 209.43. AD transformation

Compiler có thể tạo:

```text
Primal
Tangent
Adjoint
```

thay vì programmer tự viết backward.

---

# 209.44. AD phải hiểu ownership

Generated backward graph phải tuân theo:

```text
Ownership
Drop
Capability
Async
GPU
```

không tạo alias nguy hiểm.

---

# 209.45. Mutation trong AD

Mutable operations có thể làm reverse-mode khó.

Compiler cần phân biệt:

```text
Pure
Read-only
In-place
Stateful
```

---

# 209.46. Mutation legality

Nếu compiler không thể bảo toàn gradient semantics:

```text
reject
```

thay vì âm thầm tạo gradient sai.

---

# 209.47. Custom gradient

Library có thể khai báo:

```text
@custom_gradient
```

với forward/backward implementation.

Compiler vẫn kiểm tra type/ownership/ABI.

---

# 209.48. Gradient metadata

Một operation có thể cung cấp:

```text
Differentiable
NonDifferentiable
CustomDerivative
StopGradient
```

---

# 209.49. Stop gradient

Explicit:

```text
stop_gradient(x)
```

để ngắt AD graph.

---

# 209.50. Higher-order differentiation

Kiến trúc AD không được hard-code chỉ một derivative level.

Có thể:

```text
grad(grad(f))
jacobian(f)
hessian(f)
jvp(f)
vjp(f)
```

ở library/compiler layer.

---

# 209.51. Sparse tensors

Hỗ trợ:

```text
COO
CSR
CSC
BSR
Compressed
BlockSparse
```

nhưng representation là library-level.

---

# 209.52. Sparse semantics

Sparse tensor phải giữ:

```text
logical shape
storage format
indices
values
```

khác dense tensor.

---

# 209.53. Sparse zero semantics

`missing element = zero` là semantic contract của sparse representation nếu format yêu cầu.

---

# 209.54. Memory planning

Graph compiler có thể phân tích:

```text
Tensor lifetime
```

và reuse storage:

```text
A ──────┐
        └─ storage 1
B ──────┘

C ──────┐
        └─ storage 1
```

nếu lifetime không overlap.

---

# 209.55. Memory reuse

Compiler có thể biến:

```text
allocate A
free A
allocate B
```

thành cùng physical buffer.

Ownership semantics không thay đổi.

---

# 209.56. In-place operation

Ví dụ:

```text
relu_inplace(x)
```

chỉ hợp lệ khi capability analysis chứng minh không có conflicting views.

---

# 209.57. Gradient memory planning

Training graph cần phân biệt:

```text
Forward lifetime
Backward lifetime
Saved activation
Gradient
Parameter
Optimizer state
```

Compiler có thể tối ưu storage.

---

# 209.58. Activation checkpointing

Có thể trade:

```text
compute ↔ memory
```

bằng recomputation.

Đây là optimization, không semantic language feature.

---

# 209.59. Kernel abstraction

Kernel:

```axiom
@kernel
fn add(...)
```

đã được xác định trong GPU architecture.

AI kernel chỉ là một loại GPU/CPU computation.

---

# 209.60. CPU kernel

Không ép mọi tensor operation lên GPU.

Backend có thể chọn:

```text
Scalar CPU
SIMD CPU
GPU
NPU
DSP
Accelerator
```

---

# 209.61. Kernel selection

Selection dựa trên:

```text
shape
dtype
layout
target
CPU features
GPU features
memory locality
cost model
```

---

# 209.62. Kernel specialization

Ví dụ:

```text
matmul<f32, 128x128>
```

có thể được specialize.

Dynamic shape vẫn có fallback.

---

# 209.63. Comptime shape specialization

Nếu shape known:

```text
comptime
```

có thể generate optimized kernel.

Generated code phải quay lại compiler verifier.

---

# 209.64. Tensor layout specialization

Compiler có thể specialize:

```text
NCHW
NHWC
blocked
packed
```

để tối ưu cache/vectorization.

---

# 209.65. CPU vectorization

Tensor compiler có thể lower:

```text
TensorOp
 ↓
LoopNest
 ↓
SIMD
```

sử dụng SIMD infrastructure đã frozen.

---

# 209.66. GPU lowering

```text
TensorOp
 ↓
KernelIR
 ↓
GPU MIR
 ↓
SPIR-V/DXIL/MSL/WGSL/native
```

tận dụng GPU architecture 199.

---

# 209.67. Accelerator backend

Không hard-code CUDA.

Backend abstraction:

```text
CPU
CUDA
ROCm
Metal
DirectML
Vulkan
WebGPU
NPU
Custom accelerator
```

---

# 209.68. CUDA

CUDA có thể là backend/platform integration.

Không trở thành Axiom language primitive.

---

# 209.69. ROCm

Tương tự:

```text
ROCm/HIP
```

là backend ecosystem.

---

# 209.70. Unified accelerator interface

High-level Tensor API có thể:

```text
Tensor.to(device)
```

nhưng underlying execution domain vẫn explicit.

---

# 209.71. Device ownership

Device:

```text
Device
```

là resource.

Tensor giữ dependency tới Device/storage khi cần.

---

# 209.72. Device synchronization

GPU event:

```text
GpuEvent
```

đã có từ 199.

Tensor async operation có thể:

```text
Future<Tensor>
```

hoặc một operation handle tùy API.

---

# 209.73. Async tensor operations

Không được hiểu:

```text
tensor.matmul()
```

## 210.1. Không đưa mọi numeric type vào Core

Core chỉ giữ:

```text

f32
f64
```

Các loại:

```text

rational
decimal
bigint
bigfloat
interval
dual
```

Điều này giữ Core nhỏ nhưng không giới hạn khả năng toán học.

# 210.80. Scientific computing invariants — `AMATH`

### `AMATH-20`
Advanced mathematical types shall remain library-level unless required as fundamental machine semantics.

### `AMATH-21`
Generic numerical algorithms shall be expressible through compositional traits.

### `AMATH-22`
Numeric traits shall not require a universal `Number` abstraction.

### `AMATH-23`
Complex numbers shall support zero-cost representation when the target permits.

### `AMATH-24`
Rational arithmetic shall preserve denominator validity.

### `AMATH-25`
Arbitrary-precision values shall remain explicit dynamic-size values.

### `AMATH-26`
Precision shall not be silently reduced.

### `AMATH-27`
Strict floating-point semantics shall preserve required IEEE-observable behavior.

### `AMATH-28`
Fast numerical profiles shall be explicit.

### `AMATH-29`
NaN and infinity behavior shall not be silently optimized away under strict FP semantics.

### `AMATH-30`
Exact equality and approximate numerical equality shall remain distinct.

### `AMATH-31`
ULP-based comparison shall define special-value behavior explicitly.

### `AMATH-32`
Numerical algorithms may expose stability and conditioning metadata.

### `AMATH-33`
Matrix and vector abstractions shall preserve explicit layout semantics.

### `AMATH-34`
Matrix views shall support zero-copy operation where representation permits.

### `AMATH-35`
BLAS/LAPACK-style operations shall support multiple backends.

### `AMATH-36`
Vendor math libraries shall remain optional implementations.

### `AMATH-37`
FFT plans shall be cacheable using complete semantic fingerprints.

### `AMATH-38`
FFT backend selection shall preserve the active numerical profile.

### `AMATH-39`
Sparse matrix logical semantics shall remain independent from physical storage format.

### `AMATH-40`
Numerical solvers shall distinguish approximation error from language errors.

### `AMATH-41`
Adaptive numerical algorithms shall not require GC or a monolithic runtime.

### `AMATH-42`
Parallel numerical algorithms shall explicitly define reduction ordering semantics.

### `AMATH-43`
Strict reductions shall preserve their defined numerical ordering.

### `AMATH-44`
Relaxed reductions may permit reassociation only under an explicit numerical profile.

### `AMATH-45`
Scientific RNG shall remain distinct from cryptographic RNG.

### `AMATH-46`
Parallel RNG streams shall support reproducible independent streams.

### `AMATH-47`
Units of measurement may be encoded using compile-time generic/comptime metadata.

### `AMATH-48`
Unit metadata may be erased completely when it has no runtime semantic effect.

### `AMATH-49`
Invalid dimensional operations shall be rejected when provable at compile time.

### `AMATH-50`
Runtime dimensional validation shall remain available when dimensions are dynamic.

### `AMATH-51`
Fixed-point arithmetic shall provide explicit overflow/rounding semantics.

### `AMATH-52`
Saturating arithmetic shall remain distinct from wrapping and checked arithmetic.

### `AMATH-53`
Interval arithmetic shall preserve its declared enclosure semantics.

### `AMATH-54`
Directed rounding operations shall not be optimized into semantically incompatible rounding.

### `AMATH-55`
Numerical domain restrictions shall not be silently ignored.

### `AMATH-56`
Symbolic computation shall remain distinct from numerical computation.

### `AMATH-57`
Compile-time symbolic transformations shall re-enter ordinary compiler verification.

### `AMATH-58`
Numerical precision metadata shall be available to CompilerDB.

### `AMATH-59`
Math intrinsics shall remain target-aware while preserving language semantics.

### `AMATH-60`
FMA and similar transformations shall be legal only when permitted by the active numerical profile.

### `AMATH-61`
SIMD math shall preserve the semantic contract of scalar math within the selected numerical profile.

### `AMATH-62`
Numerical backend specialization shall not alter type or ownership semantics.

### `AMATH-63`
Numerical optimization shall declare its numerical preconditions.

### `AMATH-64`
Numerical optimization lacking required proof shall not be applied.

### `AMATH-65`
Scientific libraries shall support CPU and accelerator backends without changing Core semantics.

### `AMATH-66`
Numerical code shall remain compatible with freestanding Axiom where dependencies permit.

### `AMATH-67`
Scientific computing shall not require a garbage collector.

### `AMATH-68`
Scientific computing shall not require a mandatory runtime.

### `AMATH-69`
Scientific types shall remain compatible with Axiom ownership and capability semantics.

### `AMATH-70`
Numerical algorithms shall be testable against reference implementations.

**TRẠNG THÁI: FROZEN / COMPLETED**

Mục tiêu của 211 là hợp nhất các cơ chế thực thi mà Axiom đã có thành một mô hình duy nhất:

```text
   ↓

   ↓

   ↓
```

Nhưng **không biến tất cả thành một abstraction duy nhất**.

> **Computation là semantic operation; execution strategy là compiler/runtime decision khi semantics cho phép.**

# 211.1. Execution hierarchy

Axiom có các execution domain:


# 211.100. Parallelism invariants — `APAR`

### `APAR-20`
Concurrency and parallelism shall remain distinct semantic concepts.

### `APAR-21`
Execution domain shall remain distinct from ownership.

### `APAR-22`
Parallel execution shall not weaken ownership verification.

### `APAR-23`
Parallel mutable access requires proven disjointness or explicit synchronization.

### `APAR-24`
Unknown aliasing shall never be treated as independent parallel access.

### `APAR-25`
Compiler-derived parallelism shall preserve observable semantics.

### `APAR-26`
Automatic loop parallelization shall require dependence analysis.

### `APAR-27`
Parallel reduction shall have explicit ordering semantics.

### `APAR-28`
Strict floating-point reductions shall preserve required ordering.

### `APAR-29`
Relaxed numerical reductions shall require explicit permission.

### `APAR-30`
SIMD transformations shall preserve semantics.

### `APAR-31`
SIMT execution shall remain distinct from CPU threading.

### `APAR-32`
GPU warp-level behavior shall not be assumed portable unless explicitly declared.

### `APAR-33`
Task migration shall obey Send and storage/execution-domain rules.

### `APAR-34`
Pinned execution shall be explicit where required.

### `APAR-35`
Structured parallel scopes shall not implicitly detach child tasks.

### `APAR-36`
Detached execution shall be explicit.

### `APAR-37`
Parallel cancellation shall be cooperative by default.

### `APAR-38`
Task failure propagation shall have explicit policy.

### `APAR-39`
Thread pools shall remain optional runtime components.

### `APAR-40`
Scheduling policy shall not change program semantics.

### `APAR-41`
NUMA placement shall remain a performance/storage policy unless explicitly observable.

### `APAR-42`
NUMA-aware allocation shall preserve ownership semantics.

### `APAR-43`
Cache topology may guide optimization but shall not change semantics.

### `APAR-44`
Cache alignment shall be explicit when part of a performance contract.

### `APAR-45`
False-sharing diagnostics shall remain tooling/performance diagnostics.

### `APAR-46`
Task graphs shall encode explicit dependency semantics.

### `APAR-47`
Resource dependencies may be inferred from verified effect information.

### `APAR-48`
Parallel task scheduling shall respect resource dependencies.

### `APAR-49`
Independent regions may execute concurrently when capability analysis proves disjointness.

### `APAR-50`
Parallel iterators shall preserve iterator ownership semantics.

### `APAR-51`
Chunked mutable iteration shall produce disjoint capabilities.

### `APAR-52`
Work stealing shall not alter semantic ordering guarantees where ordering is observable.

### `APAR-53`
Distributed execution shall remain distinct from local memory concurrency.

### `APAR-54`
Distributed value transfer shall not be confused with local Move.

### `APAR-55`
Remote execution shall never imply a remote raw pointer.

### `APAR-56`
Zero-copy distributed execution requires explicit storage/completion contracts.

### `APAR-57`
RDMA buffers shall remain live until operation completion.

### `APAR-58`
Collective operations shall define completion and synchronization semantics.

### `APAR-59`
Distributed failure shall be represented separately from local memory failure.

### `APAR-60`
Execution placement shall not alter semantic results outside the active numerical profile.

### `APAR-61`
Automatic placement shall be an optimization/runtime decision unless explicitly constrained.

### `APAR-62`
GPU/CPU placement shall respect storage-domain rules.

### `APAR-63`
Multi-GPU execution shall treat devices as distinct execution/storage domains.

### `APAR-64`
Peer GPU memory access shall require explicit platform capability.

### `APAR-65`
HPC scheduling metadata shall not become mandatory Core semantics.

### `APAR-66`
Parallel execution shall not require garbage collection.

### `APAR-67`
Parallel execution shall not require a monolithic runtime.

### `APAR-68`
Parallel runtime components shall be tree-shakeable.

### `APAR-69`
Parallel compiler transformations shall declare legality conditions.

### `APAR-70`
Failed parallelism proofs shall preserve the original valid execution strategy.

# 212.100. Embedded/kernel invariants — `AKERNEL`

### `AKERNEL-20`
Freestanding compilation shall not require an operating system.

### `AKERNEL-21`
Freestanding compilation shall not require a garbage collector.

### `AKERNEL-22`
Freestanding compilation shall not require an allocator.

### `AKERNEL-23`
Freestanding compilation shall not require a monolithic runtime.

### `AKERNEL-24`
Core semantics shall remain identical across hosted and freestanding profiles.

### `AKERNEL-25`
Startup behavior shall be defined by target/profile contracts.

### `AKERNEL-26`
Custom entry points shall be supported.

### `AKERNEL-27`
Global initialization shall not be implicitly required.

### `AKERNEL-28`
Interrupt handlers shall have explicit ABI and execution-domain semantics.

### `AKERNEL-29`
Interrupt handlers shall not implicitly allocate, block, or await.

### `AKERNEL-30`
Hardware exceptions shall remain distinct from language panic.

### `AKERNEL-31`
MMIO shall remain distinct from ordinary memory.

### `AKERNEL-32`
Volatile access shall not be confused with atomic synchronization.

### `AKERNEL-33`
Compiler optimization shall preserve observable MMIO effects.

### `AKERNEL-34`
Physical addresses shall remain distinct from safe Axiom pointers.

### `AKERNEL-35`
DMA ownership shall explicitly track CPU/device ownership.

### `AKERNEL-36`
DMA buffers shall remain valid until operation completion.

### `AKERNEL-37`
DMA synchronization shall respect target cache-coherency rules.

### `AKERNEL-38`
Memory barriers shall distinguish compiler, CPU, device, and DMA semantics.

### `AKERNEL-39`
Unsupported atomic operations shall never silently claim stronger guarantees.

### `AKERNEL-40`
Kernel/user address domains shall remain distinct.

### `AKERNEL-41`
User memory shall not become safe kernel capability without validation.

### `AKERNEL-42`
Validation shall not imply absence of concurrent external mutation.

### `AKERNEL-43`
Virtual-memory mappings shall have explicit permissions.

### `AKERNEL-44`
Executable writable memory shall require an explicit security/system contract.

### `AKERNEL-45`
Kernel synchronization shall obey ownership and capability semantics.

### `AKERNEL-46`
Lock guards shall retain deterministic unlock behavior.

### `AKERNEL-47`
Interrupt synchronization shall restore prior hardware state correctly.

### `AKERNEL-48`
Real-time profiles may prohibit unbounded allocation and blocking.

### `AKERNEL-49`
Real-time claims shall depend on platform guarantees, not language annotations alone.

### `AKERNEL-50`
Embedded programs shall support static and bounded allocation strategies.

### `AKERNEL-51`
Kernel code shall be expressible without class inheritance or GC.

### `AKERNEL-52`
Device drivers shall be implementable using structs, functions, traits, and explicit system contracts.

### `AKERNEL-53`
Comptime may generate hardware descriptions and register abstractions.

### `AKERNEL-54`
Generated hardware code shall re-enter ordinary compiler verification.

### `AKERNEL-55`
Inline assembly shall declare observable machine effects.

### `AKERNEL-56`
Undeclared assembly effects shall not be assumed safe by the compiler.

### `AKERNEL-57`
Target-specific instructions shall remain target-gated.

### `AKERNEL-58`
Kernel compilation shall retain the same ownership verifier as application compilation.

### `AKERNEL-59`
Unsafe hardware code shall establish explicit trusted preconditions.

### `AKERNEL-60`
Safe verification shall resume after an unsafe boundary.

### `AKERNEL-61`
Bare-metal code shall support deterministic resource lifetime.

### `AKERNEL-62`
No hidden runtime dependency may be introduced by unused language features.

### `AKERNEL-63`
Kernel binaries shall support explicit linker section and symbol contracts.

### `AKERNEL-64`
Custom memory layouts shall be expressible without weakening semantic type safety.

### `AKERNEL-65`
Compiler optimizations shall remain legal under freestanding profiles.

### `AKERNEL-66`
Axiom shall support bootloader, firmware, driver, kernel, and application layers.

### `AKERNEL-67`
The language shall not require a separate kernel programming dialect.

### `AKERNEL-68`
Hardware-specific semantics shall remain isolated in system/platform layers.

### `AKERNEL-69`
Freestanding artifacts shall remain compatible with the Axiom object/link model.

### `AKERNEL-70`
Kernel and embedded programs shall remain testable through reference/simulation/hardware backends where available.

# 212.101. Kết luận kiến trúc

```text
                    AXIOM CORE
                        │
          ┌─────────────┼─────────────┐
          │             │             │

          │             │             │
```

**Không cần tạo một "Kernel Axiom" riêng.**

```text

Profile
```

Đây là kiến trúc phù hợp với mục tiêu ban đầu của Axiom: **một ngôn ngữ duy nhất từ firmware đến application, từ CPU đến GPU, nhưng không bắt application phải mang theo sự phức tạp của kernel programming.**

# 213.99. Hardware optimization invariants — `AHW`

### `AHW-20`
Core semantics shall remain ISA-independent.

### `AHW-21`
ISA features shall be represented as target capabilities.

### `AHW-22`
Unsupported instructions shall never be emitted for a target.

### `AHW-23`
Target features shall not silently alter language semantics.

### `AHW-24`
Feature-dependent code shall have explicit target contracts.

### `AHW-25`
Function multiversioning shall preserve one logical API.

### `AHW-26`
Runtime dispatch shall be removable when target features are statically known.

### `AHW-27`
Vector semantics shall remain distinct from physical register width.

### `AHW-28`
Scalable vector ISAs shall be representable without hard-coding vector length into Core semantics.

### `AHW-29`
SIMD transformations shall preserve ownership and capability rules.

### `AHW-30`
Compiler-derived NoAlias shall require proof.

### `AHW-31`
Unknown aliasing shall never justify unsafe vectorization.

### `AHW-32`
Runtime alias checks may guard optimized implementations only when fallback semantics are equivalent.

### `AHW-33`
Alignment-sensitive instructions shall require proven or contracted alignment.

### `AHW-34`
Floating-point contraction shall respect the active numerical profile.

### `AHW-35`
Constant-time contracts shall constrain backend instruction selection.

### `AHW-36`
Crypto acceleration shall preserve security semantics.

### `AHW-37`
Instruction scheduling shall preserve memory, atomic, volatile, and assembly ordering constraints.

### `AHW-38`
Inline assembly shall declare machine-visible effects.

### `AHW-39`
Assembly clobbers shall participate in register allocation.

### `AHW-40`
Internal calling conventions may be optimized independently of stable ABI contracts.

### `AHW-41`
Stable ABI boundaries shall preserve their declared representation and calling convention.

### `AHW-42`
Register allocation shall remain an implementation detail unless explicitly exposed by a system contract.

### `AHW-43`
Spilling shall not alter semantic storage identity.

### `AHW-44`
Machine legalization shall precede final instruction encoding.

### `AHW-45`
Machine verification shall reject illegal register/instruction/feature combinations.

### `AHW-46`
Object artifacts shall retain required target feature information where necessary.

### `AHW-47`
Generic specialization shall remain bounded by compiler cost policies.

### `AHW-48`
ISA-specific optimization shall not require ISA-specific source languages.

### `AHW-49`
Target-specific intrinsics shall remain explicitly target-gated.

### `AHW-50`
Portable vector APIs shall remain available independently of specific ISA intrinsics.

### `AHW-51`
CPU dispatch shall preserve semantic equivalence among implementations.

### `AHW-52`
PGO may influence hardware optimization but shall not alter semantics.

### `AHW-53`
Security hardening shall remain independent from ordinary language semantics.

### `AHW-54`
Hardware optimization metadata shall be queryable through CompilerDB.

### `AHW-55`
AI tooling shall consume compiler-proven hardware facts rather than infer correctness from assembly.

### `AHW-56`
Axiom shall support architecture-specific optimization without architecture-specific Core syntax.

### `AHW-57`
Backend cost models shall never be correctness authorities.

### `AHW-58`
Target microarchitecture models may evolve independently from language semantics.

### `AHW-59`
Axiom shall support CPU, GPU, accelerator, and future ISA backends through the same semantic pipeline.

### `AHW-60`
New hardware instructions shall be integrable without redesigning Core language semantics.

Đây là một mốc rất quan trọng. Từ đây Axiom không còn chỉ là specification của language/compiler, mà bắt đầu đặc tả **cách chính compiler Axiom tồn tại như một chương trình Axiom**.

Nguyên tắc trung tâm:

> **Compiler cuối cùng phải là một chương trình Axiom bình thường, sử dụng chính ownership, comptime, concurrency, GPU/CPU, package, build và tooling model của Axiom; không có “ngôn ngữ đặc biệt bên trong compiler”.**

# 214.98. Compiler invariants — `ACOMPILER`

### `ACOMPILER-20`
The final Axiom compiler shall be implementable in Axiom.

### `ACOMPILER-21`
Self-hosted compiler code shall obey ordinary Axiom semantic rules.

### `ACOMPILER-22`
Compiler self-hosting shall not require a special unsafe semantic mode.

### `ACOMPILER-23`
Bootstrap implementations shall be temporary implementation dependencies.

### `ACOMPILER-24`
Final compilation shall not require a third-party compiler.

### `ACOMPILER-25`
Final native linking shall not require a third-party linker.

### `ACOMPILER-26`
Platform SDKs and system ABI dependencies may remain legitimate target dependencies.

### `ACOMPILER-27`
Bootstrap stages shall be explicitly versioned.

### `ACOMPILER-28`
Self-hosting shall require semantic conformance, not merely successful compilation.

### `ACOMPILER-29`
Compiler bootstrap shall support deterministic rebuilds.

### `ACOMPILER-30`
Parallel compiler execution shall remain semantically deterministic.

### `ACOMPILER-31`
Compiler caches shall be keyed by complete semantic/codegen identity.

### `ACOMPILER-32`
Incremental compilation shall invalidate all semantically affected queries.

### `ACOMPILER-33`
Stale semantic data shall never enter production code generation.

### `ACOMPILER-34`
Verified MIR shall remain the compiler correctness boundary.

### `ACOMPILER-35`
Optimization passes shall declare proof preconditions and preserved invariants.

### `ACOMPILER-36`
Backend lowering shall preserve observable semantics.

### `ACOMPILER-37`
Linking shall preserve ABI and observable program behavior.

### `ACOMPILER-38`
Reference interpretation shall remain available as an independent semantic oracle.

### `ACOMPILER-39`
MIR interpretation shall remain available for intermediate validation.

### `ACOMPILER-40`

# 214.99. Kiến trúc bootstrap cuối cùng

Toàn bộ mục tiêu ban đầu của Axiom giờ có thể biểu diễn thành:

```text
                    AXIOM LANGUAGE
                          │
                          ▼
                    Axiom Compiler
                          │
       ┌──────────────────┼──────────────────┐
       ▼                  ▼                  ▼
    Frontend          Semantic Core       CompilerDB
       │                  │                  │
       └──────────────────┼──────────────────┘
                          ▼
                         MIR
                          │
                       Verifier
                          │
                    Verified MIR
                          │
                       OptIR
                          │
                    Axiom LIR
                          │
                    Machine Backend
                          │
                  Axiom Object Writer
                          │
                    Axiom Linker
                          │
                          ▼
                 Native Executable
```

Và chính compiler này:

```text
          Axiom Compiler Source
                    │
                    ▼

                    │
                    ▼
          recompiles itself
                    │
                    ▼
          Axiom Compiler 2
                    │
                    ▼
          reproducibility /
          conformance /
          bootstrap tests
```

Đây là **self-hosting thật sự**, chứ không chỉ là "compiler được viết bằng Axiom".

# BOOTSTRAP-215 — Formal Semantic Kernel & Unified Axiom Semantics

**TRẠNG THÁI: FROZEN / COMPLETED**

Đây là bước rất quan trọng: từ trước tới nay Axiom đã có rất nhiều subsystem được đóng băng riêng lẻ. 215 biến chúng thành **một semantic kernel thống nhất** để sau này compiler, reference interpreter, optimizer và specification đều dựa trên cùng một nền tảng.

Nguyên tắc:

> **Có đúng một định nghĩa về semantics. Mọi compiler phase, interpreter, optimizer, backend và tooling đều phải quy chiếu về định nghĩa đó.**

# 215.1. Ba tầng cần tách biệt

Axiom có ba tầng:

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│          Language Semantics          │
│   "Chương trình có nghĩa gì?"        │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────┘
                   │
┌──────────────────▼───────────────────┐
│          Abstract Machine            │
│ ownership / capability / memory ...  │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────┘
                   │
┌──────────────────▼───────────────────┐
│       Physical Implementation         │
│ CPU / GPU / ABI / registers / RAM    │
└──────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Compiler được phép thay đổi tầng dưới nhưng không được thay đổi tầng trên.

# 215.98. Formal Kernel invariants — `ASEM`

### `ASEM-20`
Axiom shall have one authoritative semantic model.

### `ASEM-21`
Compiler phases shall not independently redefine Core semantics.

### `ASEM-22`
Reference interpretation shall be based on the semantic model.

### `ASEM-23`
Verified MIR shall represent executable semantic meaning.

### `ASEM-24`
Optimization representations shall not replace semantic authority.

### `ASEM-25`
Physical representation shall remain distinct from semantic value.

### `ASEM-26`
Physical storage location shall not be observable unless explicitly contracted.

### `ASEM-27`
Ownership shall be part of semantic state.

### `ASEM-28`
Capability validity shall be part of semantic state.

### `ASEM-29`
Move shall represent an ownership transition.

### `ASEM-30`
Copy shall represent semantic value duplication.

### `ASEM-31`
Clone shall remain explicit.

### `ASEM-32`
Drop shall have deterministic semantic ordering.

### `ASEM-33`
Partial ownership states shall be representable.

### `ASEM-34`
Invalid ownership states shall be rejected before production code generation.

### `ASEM-35`
Capability lifetime shall not exceed provenance validity.

### `ASEM-36`
Unknown aliasing shall never be treated as proven disjointness.

### `ASEM-37`
Safe mutable capabilities shall obey exclusivity rules.

### `ASEM-38`
Storage domain shall remain distinct from ownership.

### `ASEM-39`
Logical identity shall remain distinct from physical address.

### `ASEM-40`
Execution domain shall remain distinct from storage domain.

### `ASEM-41`
Send shall remain distinct from Share.

### `ASEM-42`
Synchronization shall define ordering rather than ownership.

### `ASEM-43`
Atomicity shall remain distinct from memory ordering.

### `ASEM-44`
Async suspension shall be explicit semantic control flow.

### `ASEM-45`
Cancellation shall remain distinct from panic.

### `ASEM-46`
Comptime execution shall remain distinct from runtime execution.

### `ASEM-47`
Comptime external authority shall be explicit.

### `ASEM-48`
GPU execution/storage domains shall remain explicit.

### `ASEM-49`
Foreign calls shall cross explicit ABI/semantic contracts.

### `ASEM-50`
Unsafe operations shall not silently disable semantic verification.

### `ASEM-51`
Observable behavior shall define semantic equivalence.

### `ASEM-52`
Compiler optimizations shall preserve observable behavior.

### `ASEM-53`
Effectful operations shall not be eliminated without proof of non-observability.

### `ASEM-54`
Strict numerical semantics shall not be silently replaced by relaxed semantics.

### `ASEM-55`
Security contracts shall constrain optimization where required.

### `ASEM-56`
Reference semantics shall be independent of target machine representation.

### `ASEM-57`
Backend implementation shall preserve the semantic model.

### `ASEM-58`
Linking shall preserve observable program behavior.

### `ASEM-59`
Undefined behavior shall not be used as a general optimization mechanism in safe Core.

### `ASEM-60`
Semantic uncertainty shall never be promoted to proof.

### `ASEM-61`
AI-generated code shall enter the same semantic pipeline as human-written code.

### `ASEM-62`
AI tooling shall consume semantic facts rather than redefine semantics.

### `ASEM-63`
Compiler diagnostics shall be explainable in terms of semantic rules.

### `ASEM-64`
Every semantic rule shall have conformance tests.

### `ASEM-65`
Every optimization rule shall have correctness validation.

### `ASEM-66`
Every machine-level lowering boundary shall have validation coverage.

### `ASEM-67`
Semantic rules shall remain independent of optimization level.

### `ASEM-68`
Semantic rules shall remain independent of compiler parallelism.

### `ASEM-69`
Semantic rules shall remain independent of cache state.

### `ASEM-70`
Semantic rules shall remain stable across supported target architectures unless explicitly target-defined.

# 216.2. Core phải nhỏ hơn toàn bộ Axiom

Axiom có thể rất lớn về ecosystem nhưng Core vẫn chỉ chứa những semantic primitive thực sự cần thiết.

Ví dụ:

```text
view<T>
mut_view<T>
```

là Core semantic primitives.

Nhưng:

```text
Vec<T>
HashMap<K,V>
TcpStream
Tensor<T>
Window
```

không phải Core.

---

# 216.3. Compiler complexity không phải language complexity

Một tính năng có thể khiến compiler rất phức tạp nhưng programmer vẫn không cần biết.

Ví dụ:

```text
ownership inference
escape analysis
alias analysis
lifetime inference
allocation elimination
vectorization
specialization
```

được compiler xử lý.

Không biến chúng thành annotation bắt buộc.

---

# 216.4. Explicit semantic boundaries

Ngược lại, những thứ có thể thay đổi observable behavior phải explicit.

Ví dụ:

```text
unsafe
async
spawn
atomic
FFI
GPU transfer
fast-math
stable ABI
serialization
```

---

# 216.5. Precedence rules

Nếu hai rule xung đột, thứ tự ưu tiên:

```text
1. Memory / type / ownership safety
2. Observable semantics
3. Explicit programmer contract
4. ABI/platform contract
5. Optimization freedom
6. Compiler implementation heuristic
```

Không được dùng optimization để phá semantic rule.

---

# 216.6. Safety vs optimization

Nếu compiler không chứng minh được optimization an toàn:

```text
DO NOT OPTIMIZE
```

Không được:

```text
ASSUME SAFE
```

---

# 216.7. Explicit contract vs inference

Nếu programmer cung cấp contract:

```text
@repr(C)
@abi(stable)
@target_feature(...)
@constant_time
```

compiler phải tuân thủ contract.

Nếu không có contract, compiler được tự tối ưu trong semantic freedom.

---

# 216.8. Core language freeze

Axiom v1.0 Core không bao gồm:

```text
GC
class
inheritance
exceptions
runtime reflection
mandatory runtime
mandatory heap
mandatory pointer syntax
borrow annotations
lifetime annotations
macro language
```

# 216.72. Feature admission rule

```text
1. Không thể biểu diễn chính xác bằng existing primitives
2. Compiler cần hiểu để guarantee safety/correctness
3. Feature là observable semantic contract
4. Feature là fundamental syntax/control-flow primitive
```

# 216.98. Final Axiom v1.0 invariants — `ASPEC`

### `ASPEC-20`
Axiom shall maintain one authoritative semantic hierarchy.

### `ASPEC-21`
Formal Semantic Kernel has precedence over implementation notes.

### `ASPEC-22`
Core semantics shall remain independent of standard-library implementation.

### `ASPEC-23`
Compiler implementation shall not silently define language semantics.

### `ASPEC-24`
Library functionality shall remain library-level whenever existing Core primitives suffice.

### `ASPEC-25`
Compiler-known library optimizations shall preserve ordinary semantic contracts.

### `ASPEC-26`
Explicit semantic boundaries shall remain explicit.

### `ASPEC-27`
Unsafe shall never imply unrestricted semantic bypass.

### `ASPEC-28`
No mandatory garbage collector shall exist in Core.

### `ASPEC-29`
No mandatory runtime shall exist in Core.

### `ASPEC-30`
No mandatory heap allocation shall exist in Core.

### `ASPEC-31`
No programmer-written lifetime annotations shall be required by Core.

### `ASPEC-32`
No programmer-written borrow-checking annotations shall be required by Core.

### `ASPEC-33`
No general class/inheritance hierarchy shall exist in Core.

### `ASPEC-34`
No mandatory exception mechanism shall exist in Core.

### `ASPEC-35`
No implicit null reference shall exist in safe Core.

### `ASPEC-36`
Ownership and capability semantics shall remain distinct.

### `ASPEC-37`
Logical identity shall remain distinct from storage address.

### `ASPEC-38`
Memory representation shall remain distinct from semantic value.

### `ASPEC-39`
Wire representation shall remain distinct from memory representation.

### `ASPEC-40`
Stable ABI shall remain explicit.

### `ASPEC-41`
FFI shall remain an explicit semantic boundary.

### `ASPEC-42`
GPU and accelerator semantics shall not contaminate ordinary CPU Core semantics.

### `ASPEC-43`
AI tooling shall not become part of semantic correctness.

### `ASPEC-44`
All normative Core features shall have semantic definitions.

### `ASPEC-45`
All normative features shall have conformance tests.

### `ASPEC-46`
Experimental features shall not silently enter the v1.0 semantic contract.

### `ASPEC-47`
Implementation freedom shall be preserved wherever observable semantics permit.

### `ASPEC-48`
Optimization freedom shall be preserved wherever observable semantics permit.

### `ASPEC-49`
Compiler inability to prove an optimization shall result in omission of that optimization, not semantic weakening.

### `ASPEC-50`
Unknown shall never be promoted to Proven.

### `ASPEC-51`
The language shall remain implementable by an independent compiler.

### `ASPEC-52`
The language specification shall not require the reference compiler implementation to define semantics.

### `ASPEC-53`
Axiom v1.0 shall be internally consistent across Core, compiler, ABI, system and library contracts.

### `ASPEC-54`
Any future semantic change shall require an explicit language-version decision.

### `ASPEC-55`
Existing frozen semantics shall not be silently reinterpreted by later features.

# 217.1. Syntax philosophy

Axiom ưu tiên:

```text
Readable
Predictable
Explicit at boundaries
Compact in ordinary code
Easy to parse
Easy for AI to generate
Easy for compiler to recover
```

Không theo mục tiêu:

```text
ít ký tự nhất
nhiều magic nhất
giống C nhất
```

# 217.2. Canonical example

Một chương trình Axiom cơ bản:

```axiom
    let a = 10
    let b = 20

    print(c)
}
```

Không cần:

```text
;
&reference
lifetime
new
delete
```

Không cần `;`.

` ; ` có thể tồn tại như explicit terminator trong machine-generated hoặc compact syntax, nhưng không phải bắt buộc trong canonical style.

# 217.66. Result matching

```axiom
match operation() {
    Ok(value) => use(value)
    Err(error) => handle(error)
}
```

---

# 217.67. Panic

```axiom
panic("invalid state")
```

Panic không phải exception.

---

# 217.68. Assertions

```axiom
assert(x >= 0)
```

và:

```axiom
debug_assert(condition)
```

là library/compiler-supported primitives tùy profile.

---

# 217.69. Async

```axiom
async fn fetch(url: Str) -> Result<Data> {
    ...
}
```

Await:

```axiom
let data = fetch(url).await?
```

---

# 217.70. Spawn

`spawn` không thuộc semantic `async fn`.

Library/runtime:

```axiom
spawn(task)
```

Compiler kiểm tra `Send` theo execution contract.

---

# 217.71. Comptime

```axiom
const MAX: usize = 1024
```

Compile-time value.

---

# 217.72. Comptime execution

```axiom
comptime {
    generate_tables()
}
```

---

# 217.73. Comptime function

```axiom
comptime fn make_value() -> i32 {
    42
}
```

---

# 217.74. Compile-time reflection

Conceptual syntax:

```axiom
comptime {
    let fields = reflect(Point).fields()
}
```

Reflection API là compiler-provided capability/library interface.

---

# 217.75. Attributes

Axiom dùng:

```axiom
@attribute(...)
```

Ví dụ:

```axiom
@repr(C)
struct Header {
    ...
}
```
